157  
158  ACTOR_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\[(.+)\]$")
159  CASE_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\(\[(.+)\]\)$")
160  BOUNDARY_LINE = re.compile(r"^subgraph\s+\w+\[(.+)\]$")
161  ASSOC_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\s+---\s+(\w+)$")
162  EXTEND_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\s+-\.->\|([^|]+)\|\s+(\w+)$")
163  BREAK_LINE = re.compile(r"<br\s*/?>")
164  
165  
166  def parse_usecase(source: str) -> tuple[str, list, list, list, list]:
167      actors: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
168      cases: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
169      assocs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
170      extends: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
171      boundary = "시스템"
172      for raw in source.splitlines():
173          line = raw.strip()
174          if not line or line.startswith(("%%", "flowchart", "direction")) or line == "end":
175              continue
176          found = BOUNDARY_LINE.match(line)
177          if found:
178              boundary = found.group(1)
179              continue
180          found = CASE_LINE.match(line)
181          if found:
182              cases.append((found.group(1), found.group(2)))
183              continue
184          found = ACTOR_LINE.match(line)
185          if found:
186              actors.append((found.group(1), found.group(2)))
187              continue
188          found = ASSOC_LINE.match(line)
189          if found:
190              assocs.append((found.group(1), found.group(2)))
191              continue
192          found = EXTEND_LINE.match(line)
193          if found:
194              extends.append((found.group(1), found.group(2), found.group(3)))
195      if not actors or not cases:
196          raise SystemExit("사람 그림으로 그릴 행위자나 유스케이스가 없습니다.")
197      return boundary, actors, cases, assocs, extends
198  
199  
200  def text_width(text: str) -> int:
201      return sum(17 if ord(char) > 127 else 9 for char in text)
202  
203  
204  def usecase_svg(source: str) -> str:
205      boundary, actors, cases, assocs, extends = parse_usecase(source)
206      parsed = [(case_id, BREAK_LINE.split(label)) for case_id, label in cases]
207      ellipse_w = max(max(text_width(line) for line in lines) for _, lines in parsed) + 52
208      row_h = 78
209      ellipse_h = 50
210      pad_top = 40
211      pad_x = 48
212      boundary_x = 188
213      boundary_y = 10
214      extend_room = 28
215      boundary_w = pad_x + ellipse_w + pad_x + extend_room
216      boundary_h = pad_top + row_h * len(parsed) + 8
217      ellipse_x = boundary_x + pad_x
218      centers: dict[str, float] = {}
219      for index, (case_id, _) in enumerate(parsed):
220          centers[case_id] = boundary_y + pad_top + index * row_h + ellipse_h / 2
221      linked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
222      for actor_id, case_id in assocs:
223          linked.setdefault(actor_id, []).append(case_id)
224  
225      def actor_anchor(actor_id: str) -> float:
226          targets = linked.get(actor_id, [])
227          if not targets:
228              return boundary_y + boundary_h / 2
229          return sum(centers[case_id] for case_id in targets) / len(targets)
230  
231      width = boundary_x + boundary_w + 20
232      height = boundary_y + boundary_h + 28
233      parts = [
234          f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">',
235          "<defs><marker id='extend-arrow' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='7' refY='4' orient='auto'>",
236          "<path d='M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z' fill='#555'/></marker></defs>",
237          f"<rect x='{boundary_x}' y='{boundary_y}' width='{boundary_w}' height='{boundary_h}' fill='none' stroke='#9a9a9a' stroke-width='1.4'/>",
238          f"<text x='{boundary_x + boundary_w / 2}' y='{boundary_y + 24}' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#333'>{html.escape(boundary)}</text>",
239      ]
240      hands: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
241      for index, (actor_id, name) in enumerate(actors):
242          center_x = 78
243          center_y = actor_anchor(actor_id)
244          radius = 13
245          head_y = center_y - 34
246          neck = head_y + radius
247          hip = neck + 30
248          arm_y = neck + 12
249          foot = hip + 24
250          arm = 20
251          leg = 15
252          parts.append(
253              f"<g fill='none' stroke='#222' stroke-width='1.7' stroke-linecap='round'>"
254              f"<circle cx='{center_x}' cy='{head_y}' r='{radius}'/>"
255              f"<line x1='{center_x}' y1='{neck}' x2='{center_x}' y2='{hip}'/>"
256              f"<line x1='{center_x - arm}' y1='{arm_y}' x2='{center_x + arm}' y2='{arm_y}'/>"
257              f"<line x1='{center_x}' y1='{hip}' x2='{center_x - leg}' y2='{foot}'/>"
258              f"<line x1='{center_x}' y1='{hip}' x2='{center_x + leg}' y2='{foot}'/>"
259              f"</g>"
260              f"<text x='{center_x}' y='{foot + 20}' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#222'>{html.escape(name)}</text>"
261          )
262          hands[actor_id] = (center_x + arm, arm_y)
263      for actor_id, case_id in assocs:
264          start_x, start_y = hands[actor_id]
265          end_x = ellipse_x
266          end_y = centers[case_id]
267          bend = (start_x + end_x) / 2
268          parts.append(
269              f"<path d='M {start_x} {start_y} C {bend} {start_y}, {bend} {end_y}, {end_x} {end_y}' fill='none' stroke='#777' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
270          )
271      right = ellipse_x + ellipse_w
272      for source_id, label, target_id in extends:
273          start_y = centers[source_id]
274          end_y = centers[target_id]
275          lane = right + 16
276          mid_y = (start_y + end_y) / 2
277          parts.append(
278              f"<path d='M {right} {start_y} C {lane} {start_y}, {lane} {end_y}, {right} {end_y}' fill='none' stroke='#555' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-dasharray='4 3' marker-end='url(#extend-arrow)'/>"
279              f"<text x='{lane + 8}' y='{mid_y + 4}' font-size='13' fill='#333'>{html.escape(label)}</text>"
280          )
281      for case_id, lines in parsed:
282          center_y = centers[case_id]
283          parts.append(
284              f"<ellipse cx='{ellipse_x + ellipse_w / 2}' cy='{center_y}' rx='{ellipse_w / 2}' ry='{ellipse_h / 2}' fill='#f4f4f4' stroke='#666' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
285          )
286          if len(lines) == 1:
287              parts.append(
288                  f"<text x='{ellipse_x + ellipse_w / 2}' y='{center_y + 5}' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#222'>{html.escape(lines[0])}</text>"
289              )
290          else:
291              first = center_y - 6
292              spans = "".join(
293                  f"<tspan x='{ellipse_x + ellipse_w / 2}' y='{first + offset * 18}'>{html.escape(line)}</tspan>"
294                  for offset, line in enumerate(lines)
295              )
296              parts.append(f"<text text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#222'>{spans}</text>")
297      parts.append("</svg>")
298      return "".join(parts)

344  def crop_whitespace(path: Path) -> None:
345      image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
346      background = Image.new("RGB", image.size, (255, 255, 255))
347      box = ImageChops.difference(image, background).getbbox()
348      if box is None:
349          raise SystemExit(f"차트가 비어 있습니다: {path.name}")
350      pad = 16
351      left = max(box[0] - pad, 0)
352      top = max(box[1] - pad, 0)
353      right = min(box[2] + pad, image.width)
354      bottom = min(box[3] + pad, image.height)
355      cropped = image.crop((left, top, right, bottom))
356      if cropped.width < 40 or cropped.height < 40:
357          raise SystemExit(f"차트가 너무 작습니다: {path.name}")
358      cropped.save(path)

361  def render_diagram(source: str) -> str:
362      digest = hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
363      USED_DIAGRAMS.add(digest)
364      DIAGRAMS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
365      png = DIAGRAMS / f"{digest}.png"
366      if not png.is_file():
367          browser = find_browser()
368          if browser is None:
369              raise SystemExit("차트를 그릴 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
370          html_path = DIAGRAMS / f"{digest}.html"
371          html_path.write_text(diagram_page(source), encoding="utf-8")
372          profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="specs-chart-"))
373          command = [
374              str(browser),
375              "--headless=new",
376              "--disable-gpu",
377              "--no-first-run",
378              "--hide-scrollbars",
379              "--force-device-scale-factor=2",
380              "--virtual-time-budget=12000",
381              "--window-size=1400,2200",
382              f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
383              f"--screenshot={png.resolve()}",
384              html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
385          ]
386          try:
387              subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=60)
388              deadline = time.time() + 8
389              while not png.is_file() and time.time() < deadline:
390                  time.sleep(0.2)
391          finally:
392              html_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
393              shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
394          if not png.is_file():
395              raise SystemExit(f"차트 이미지가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {png.name}")
396          crop_whitespace(png)
397      relative = png.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
398      return f'<figure class="chart"><img src="{html.escape(relative)}" alt="차트" /></figure>'
399  
400  
401  def cleanup_diagrams() -> None:
402      if not DIAGRAMS.is_dir():
403          return
404      for path in DIAGRAMS.iterdir():
405          if path.is_dir():
406              shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
407          elif path.stem not in USED_DIAGRAMS:
408              path.unlink()

411  def write_pdf(html_path: Path, pdf_path: Path) -> None:
412      browser = find_browser()
413      if browser is None:
414          raise SystemExit("PDF로 인쇄할 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
415      if pdf_path.exists():
416          pdf_path.unlink()
417      profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="specs-pdf-"))
418      command = [
419          str(browser),
420          "--headless=new",
421          "--disable-gpu",
422          "--no-first-run",
423          "--no-pdf-header-footer",
424          f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
425          f"--print-to-pdf={pdf_path.resolve()}",
426          html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
427      ]
428      try:
429          subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=120)
430      finally:
431          shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
432      if not pdf_path.is_file() or pdf_path.stat().st_size < 1000:
433          raise SystemExit(f"PDF가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {pdf_path}")
434  
435  
436  def main() -> None:
437      markdown = combined_markdown()
438      MD_PATH.write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")
439      HTML_PATH.write_text(render_html(markdown_to_html(markdown)), encoding="utf-8")
440      cleanup_diagrams()
441      write_pdf(HTML_PATH, PDF_PATH)
442      print(f"Wrote {MD_PATH}")
443      print(f"Wrote {HTML_PATH}")
444      print(f"Wrote {PDF_PATH} ({PDF_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
445  
446  
447  if __name__ == "__main__":
448      main()

milestone_schdule/doc-publication/codebook.html

 1  <!DOCTYPE html>
 2  <html lang="ko">
 3  <head>
 4  <meta charset="utf-8" />
 5  <title>코드북</title>
 6  <style>
 7  
 8  @page { margin: 18mm 16mm; }
 9  body { font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.55; color: #1c1c1c; }
10  h1 { font-size: 20pt; margin: 0 0 0.6em; page-break-before: always; }
11  h1:first-of-type { page-break-before: auto; }
12  h2 { font-size: 15pt; margin: 1.2em 0 0.4em; page-break-after: avoid; }
13  h3 { font-size: 12.5pt; margin: 1em 0 0.3em; page-break-after: avoid; }
14  p, li { orphans: 3; widows: 3; }
15  ul, ol { margin: 0.2em 0 0.8em; padding-left: 1.2em; }
16  code { font-family: Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace; font-size: 9.5pt; }
17  pre { font-family: Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace; font-size: 9pt; background: #f3f3f3;
18        padding: 8px 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
19  
20  </style>
21  </head>
22  <body>
23  <h1>코드북 · 하루일과</h1>
24  <h2>이 책이 맡는 일</h2>
25  <p>소스 파일을 <strong>읽는 순서</strong>와 <strong>구간별 역할</strong>로 풀어 쓴다. 함수 시그니처·유사코드는 <code>code-reference.pdf</code>에, 요구·DFD는 <code>technical-specs.pdf</code>에 있다.</p>
26  <h2>5종 PDF 관계</h2>
27  <ol><li><strong>technical-specs</strong> — WHAT/WHY (요구·흐름·시험)</li><li><strong>codebook</strong> — WHERE/HOW 개요 (본 문서)</li><li><strong>code-reference</strong> — 함수·api_* 상세</li><li><strong>source-bundle</strong> — 주석 포함 원문 나열</li><li><strong>portfolio-book</strong> — 제품·Cursor·닷홈 스토리</li></ol>
28  <h2>읽는 순서</h2>
29  <ol><li>index·인증 UI</li><li>app.js 핵심</li><li>API 세션·로그인</li><li>journal API</li><li>styles·design</li><li>profile</li><li>doc-publication 빌드</li></ol>
30  <h1>index.html · 로그인·세션 UI</h1>
31  <h2>이 파일이 맡는 일</h2>
32  <p>단일 페이지 진입점. 로그인 카드와 로그인 후 캘린더·헤더·journal 모달 DOM을 한 HTML에 둔다.</p>
33  <h2>읽는 순서</h2>
34  <ol><li><code>&lt;head&gt;</code> — styles.css, app.js</li><li><code>#auth-view</code> — 로그인 폼(1열)</li><li><code>#app-view</code> — 캘린더·툴바·모달 마크업</li><li>푸터 — ©, GitHub <code>@ackdark23358</code></li></ol>
35  <h2>구간</h2>
36  <ul><li><strong>시맨틱</strong>: main, button type, aria 레이블(테마·모달)</li><li><strong>세션 행</strong>: 로그아웃·프로필 링크 — CSS flex로 버튼 정렬</li><li><strong>register 링크 없음</strong> — 회원가입 비활성 정책</li></ul>
37  <p><code>app.js</code>가 <code>session.php</code>로 초기 화면을 auth/app 중 선택한다.</p>
38  <h1>js/app.js · SPA 코어</h1>
39  <h2>이 파일이 맡는 일</h2>
40  <p>인증, 캘린더 렌더, journal 모달 CRUD, <code>fetch</code> API, localStorage 보조 캐시, 테마.</p>
41  <h2>읽는 순서</h2>
42  <ol><li>파일 헤더 JSDoc — STORAGE 키 설명</li><li>journal read/write — <code>readJournalForDate</code>, <code>writeJournalForDate</code></li><li>API 헬퍼 — <code>apiFetch</code>, JSON 오류 처리</li><li><code>initAuth</code> / <code>checkSession</code> — session.php</li><li>캘린더 — <code>renderCalendar</code>, 날짜 클릭, 미래 비활성</li><li>모달 — entries 배열, 상태별 UI, 저장 → save-journal.php</li><li><code>list-dates</code> 새로고침, 다크 모드</li></ol>
43  <h2>구간 메모</h2>
44  <ul><li><strong>entries JSON</strong>: id(uuid), text, state</li><li><strong>960px 브레이크</strong>: 칸반 3열 vs 1열 — CSS 클래스와 연동</li><li><strong>레거시 키</strong>: <code>STORAGE_KEY_MILESTONES</code> 등 정리용 상수 유지</li></ul>
45  <p>줄 단위 설명은 code-reference의 <code>function</code> 목록을 본다.</p>
46  <h1>API · 세션·인증</h1>
47  <h2>db.php</h2>
48  <p>PDO 연결, <code>api_send_json</code>, 세션 시작·쿠키 Secure, 비밀번호 검증, <strong>로그인 rate limit</strong> (<code>api/_security_data/</code>), admin 설정 로드.</p>
49  <p>읽기 순서: JSON/메서드 가드 → rate limit → session → validation → journal 헬퍼(하단).</p>
50  <h2>login.php</h2>
51  <p>POST 전용. rate limit → admin 자격 → 세션 user_id.</p>
52  <h2>logout.php / session.php</h2>
53  <p>세션 파기 vs 현재 사용자 JSON.</p>
54  <h2>check-user.php</h2>
55  <p>클라이언트 검증 보조. <strong>usernameExists 미노출</strong>(보안).</p>
56  <h2>config</h2>
57  <ul><li><code>config.sample.php</code> — 저장소 예시</li><li><code>config.php</code> — gitignore, FTP만 배치</li></ul>
58  <h2>debug-db.php</h2>
59  <p><code>security.debug_db_enabled</code>가 true일 때만 진단 JSON.</p>
60  <h1>API · journal·캘린더 날짜</h1>
61  <h2>journal.php</h2>
62  <p>GET <code>?date=YYYY-MM-DD</code> — 로그인 필수, content JSON 또는 빈 entries.</p>
63  <h2>save-journal.php</h2>
64  <p>POST body: date + entries. 빈 배열이면 delete journal + activity_dates.</p>
65  <h2>list-dates.php</h2>
66  <p>GET — 사용자의 journal_date 목록. 프론트 ✓ 갱신에 사용.</p>
67  <h2>db.php journal 헬퍼</h2>
68  <ul><li><code>api_build_journal_content_from_daily</code> — legacy daily 연동</li><li><code>api_upsert_journal</code> / <code>api_delete_journal</code></li><li><code>api_journal_content_has_entries</code></li><li><code>api_fetch_calendar_dates</code></li></ul>
69  <h2>state.php (레거시)</h2>
70  <p>마일스톤·daily workspace GET/POST. 현행 UI는 save-journal 경로 우선.</p>
71  <h1>css/styles.css · Aurora UI</h1>
72  <h2>이 파일이 맡는 일</h2>
73  <p>오로라 mesh 배경, 글래스 카드, Primary <code>#0080FF</code>, 다크 모드, 캘린더·모달·로그인 1열 레이아웃.</p>
74  <h2>design.md</h2>
75  <p>YAML front matter + Aurora 토큰(primary/secondary/tertiary). styles.css가 실제 구현.</p>
76  <h2>핵심 토큰</h2>
77  <ul><li><code>--content-column-max: 36rem</code> — 로그인·캘린더 폭 통일</li><li>브레이크포인트 1280 / 960 / 768 / 640</li><li>journal 모달: 상태별 색·뱃지, 칸반 vs 스택</li></ul>
78  <h2>모바일</h2>
79  <p><code>overflow-x: hidden</code>, <code>100dvh</code>, 터치 영역 버튼 padding.</p>
80  <h1>profile.html · js/profile.js</h1>
81  <h2>profile.html</h2>
82  <p>세션 필요. 닉네임·비밀번호 변경 폼 1열, index 링크, 동일 푸터(GitHub).</p>
83  <h2>profile.js</h2>
84  <ol><li>session/profile.php 로드</li><li><code>user-validation.js</code> 규칙</li><li><code>update-profile.php</code> POST</li><li>오류·성공 메시지 Aurora 토스트/인라인</li></ol>
85  <h2>delete-account.php</h2>
86  <p>관리자 username 탈퇴 차단 — db.php <code>api_is_admin_username</code>.</p>
87  <h1>doc-publication 빌드</h1>
88  <h2>build_all.py</h2>
89  <p>다섯 스크립트를 순서대로 subprocess 실행.</p>
90  <h2>build_specs.py / build_codebook.py / build_portfolio_book.py</h2>
91  <p><code>specs/</code>, <code>codebook/</code>, <code>portfolio-book/</code>의 <code>*.md</code>를 정렬·합친 뒤 HTML → Edge/Chrome PDF. Mermaid는 headless PNG 삽입(Pillow 크롭).</p>
92  <h2>build_code_reference.py</h2>
93  <p>저장소 <code>js/</code>, <code>api/*.php</code>(config 제외) 파싱 → code-reference.pdf.</p>
94  <h2>build_source_bundle.py</h2>
95  <p>index/profile, css/, js/, api/*.php 원문 번들. config·_security_data 제외.</p>
96  <h2>산출물</h2>
97  <p>루트 <code>.gitignore</code>에 <code>doc-publication/*.pdf</code> 등 — FTP 업로드 제외.</p>
98  </body>
99  </html>

216  <h1 class="book-title">하루일과 포트폴리오 북</h1>
217  <h3>캘린더 날짜별 할일 · 닷홈 PHP/MySQL · Aurora UI</h3>
218  <hr class="divider" />
219  <ul><li><strong>작성자</strong>: GitHub <a href="https://github.com/ackdark23358">@ackdark23358</a></li><li><strong>저장소</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/ackdark23358/milestone_schdule">ackdark23358/milestone_schdule</a></li><li><strong>개발 환경</strong>: Cursor AI, Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, PHP, MySQL, Python(doc-publication)</li><li><strong>발행일</strong>: 2026년 10월 11일</li><li><strong>©</strong>: 웹 푸터와 동일 — Copyright, GitHub 링크</li></ul>
220  <hr class="divider" />
221  <blockquote><p><strong>AI 선언</strong><br />학습·과제 원문을 제외한 설명 문장은 Cursor AI와 대화하며 다듬었습니다. 아키텍처·보안·배포·문서 체계의 최종 판단과 책임은 작성자에게 있습니다.</p></blockquote>
222  <hr class="divider" />
223  <h2>목차</h2>
224  <ul><li><strong>제1장</strong> 프로젝트 소개</li><li><strong>제2장</strong> Cursor 바이브 코딩</li><li><strong>제3장</strong> doc-publication 5종 PDF</li><li><strong>제4장</strong> 기능·아키텍처</li><li><strong>제5장</strong> 닷홈 배포·보안</li><li><strong>제6장</strong> 맺음말</li></ul>
225  <h1 class="chapter-title">제1장 · 프로젝트 소개</h1>
226  <h2>문제·목표</h2>
227  <p>하루 단위로 할일을 남기고, <strong>날짜를 눌러</strong> 과거 기록을 다시 보고 싶었다. 프레임워크 없이 가볍게, 닷홈 호스팅에서도 돌아가게 만들었다.</p>
228  <h2>한 줄 정의</h2>
229  <p><strong>하루일과</strong> — 관리자 로그인 후 캘린더에서 journal(할일 JSON) CRUD.</p>
230  <h2>스택</h2>
231  <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>층</th><th>기술</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>UI</td><td>HTML, Aurora CSS, 바닐라 JS</td></tr><tr><td>API</td><td>PHP 7+, JSON, 세션 쿠키</td></tr><tr><td>DB</td><td>MySQL journals/users</td></tr><tr><td>문서</td><td>doc-publication Python → PDF</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
232  <h2>배포</h2>
233  <p>닷홈 FTP: <code>index.html</code>, <code>css/</code>, <code>js/</code>, <code>api/</code>(config.php는 서버만). PDF 문서는 개발 산출물로 FTP 제외.</p>
234  <h1 class="chapter-title">제2장 · Cursor 바이브 코딩</h1>
235  <h2>흐름</h2>
236  <ol><li><strong>Ask</strong> — Aurora UI, 닷홈 제약, 보안(로그인 메시지, rate limit) 질문</li><li><strong>Plan</strong> — README·design.md 기준으로 UI 폭·모바일·journal 모달 개선 계획</li><li><strong>Agent</strong> — <code>app.js</code>, <code>styles.css</code>, <code>api/db.php</code> 멀티파일 수정, README 갱신</li></ol>
237  <h2>이 저장소에서 한 일 (예)</h2>
238  <ul><li>로그인·캘린더 <code>--content-column-max</code> 통일</li><li>journal 상태별 칸반/스택</li><li>로그인 유지(30일) 제거 — 세션 단순화</li><li>2026-10-11 보안: rate limit, check-user, debug-db 가드</li><li><strong>doc-publication</strong> — 다른 프로젝트 <code>docs/</code> 패턴을 하루일과 루트에 이식</li></ul>
239  <h2>원칙</h2>
240  <p>프롬프트에 의도를 명확히 쓰고, diff·README로 변경 이유를 남긴다.</p>
241  <h1 class="chapter-title">제3장 · doc-publication 5종 PDF</h1>
242  <h2>생태계</h2>
243  <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>PDF</th><th>역할</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>technical-specs</td><td>요구·DFD·시험</td></tr><tr><td>codebook</td><td>파일 읽기 순서</td></tr><tr><td>code-reference</td><td>함수·api_*</td></tr><tr><td>source-bundle</td><td>원문 아카이브</td></tr><tr><td>portfolio-book</td><td>본 책</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
244  <h2>파이프라인</h2>
245  <p>마크다운 챕터 → HTML(맑은 고딕) → Edge/Chrome headless PDF. Mermaid는 PNG 렌더 후 삽입.</p>
246  <h2>왜 <code>doc-publication/</code>?</h2>
247  <p>참고 <code>docs/</code>는 <strong>다른 포트폴리오 저장소</strong> 산출물이다. 하루일과 전용 문서는 루트 <code>doc-publication/</code>만 수정해 혼선을 막는다.</p>
248  <h2>실행</h2>
249  <pre class="code"><code>python doc-publication/build_all.py
250  </code></pre>
251  <h1 class="chapter-title">제4장 · 기능·아키텍처</h1>
252  <h2>SPA + API</h2>
253  <p>브라우저는 <code>index.html</code> 하나. 상태는 세션(PHP) + localStorage(테마·✓ 캐시). 기록의 정본은 MySQL <code>journals.content</code> JSON.</p>
254  <h2>캘린더 CRUD</h2>
255  <ul><li><code>list-dates.php</code> — ✓</li><li><code>journal.php</code> / <code>save-journal.php</code> — 읽기·쓰기</li><li>미래 날짜 차단</li></ul>
256  <h2>할일 상태</h2>
257  <p>pending / in-progress / completed — 모달에서 시각 그룹, 저장 시 JSON.</p>
258  <h2>레거시</h2>
259  <p><code>api/state.php</code>, milestones/daily_tasks — 이전 workspace 모델. 명세·코드북에 표기만 유지.</p>
260  <h2>UI</h2>
261  <p>design.md Aurora: mesh gradient, Electric Blue Primary, 다크 모드, 반응형.</p>
262  <h1 class="chapter-title">제5장 · 닷홈 배포·보안</h1>
263  <h2>FTP</h2>
264  <ul><li>업로드: html 루트에 <code>index.html</code>, <code>profile.html</code>, <code>css/</code>, <code>js/</code>, <code>api/*.php</code>( <strong><code>config.php</code>는 서버에서 직접 생성</strong> )</li><li>제외: <code>doc-publication/*.pdf</code>, <code>database/*.sql</code> 덤프, <code>.git</code></li></ul>
265  <h2>config.php</h2>
266  <p>DB 호스트·이름·admin 해시. gitignore — 유출 방지.</p>
267  <h2>_security_data</h2>
268  <p>로그인 rate limit JSON. gitignore. API가 IP별 실패 횟수 기록.</p>
269  <h2>HTTPS</h2>
270  <p>닷홈 SSL 활성 시 세션 쿠키 Secure 경로 (<code>api/db.php</code>).</p>
271  <h2>2026-10-11 보안 요약</h2>
272  <ul><li>로그인 실패 메시지 통일</li><li>rate limit</li><li>check-user 정보 축소</li><li>debug-db 설정 플래그</li></ul>
273  <h1 class="chapter-title">제6장 · 맺음말</h1>
274  <h2>배운 점</h2>
275  <ul><li>프레임워크 없이도 <strong>세션·JSON API·SPA</strong>를 나누면 닷홈에서도 유지보수 가능</li><li><strong>문서 파이프라인</strong>을 제품 옆에 두면 README·PDF·코드북이 같이 자란다</li><li>Cursor Agent는 UI 디테일(폭·모바일·모달)과 보안 패치를 빠르게 반복하는 데 유리</li></ul>
276  <h2>확장 아이디어</h2>
277  <ul><li>다중 사용자(현재 admin 단일) 정책 명확화</li><li>journal 검색·태그</li><li>CI에서 PDF smoke test(선택)</li></ul>
278  <hr class="divider" />
279  <p>GitHub <a href="https://github.com/ackdark23358">@ackdark23358</a> · <strong>하루일과</strong></p>
280  </body>
281  </html>

  20  <h1>하루일과 · 소스 모음</h1><p>index/profile HTML, css/, js/, api/*.php 를 저장소 경로 순으로 이어 두었습니다. 비밀 설정(api/config.php), rate limit JSON(api/_security_data/), 문서 빌드 스크립트, DB 덤프는 포함하지 않았습니다.</p>
  21  <h2>api/check-user.php</h2>
  22  <pre> 1  &lt;?php
  23   2  
  24   3  require_once dirname(__FILE__) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . &#x27;db.php&#x27;;
  25   4  
  26   5  api_handle_options();
  27   6  api_require_method(&#x27;GET&#x27;);
  28   7  
  29   8  $usernameRaw = isset($_GET[&#x27;username&#x27;]) ? trim((string)$_GET[&#x27;username&#x27;]) : &#x27;&#x27;;
  30   9  $nicknameRaw = isset($_GET[&#x27;nickname&#x27;]) ? trim((string)$_GET[&#x27;nickname&#x27;]) : &#x27;&#x27;;
  31  10  $excludeUserId = isset($_GET[&#x27;excludeUserId&#x27;]) ? (int)$_GET[&#x27;excludeUserId&#x27;] : 0;
  32  11  
  33  12  $out = array(
  34  13      &#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; true,
  35  14      &#x27;usernameExists&#x27; =&gt; false,
  36  15      &#x27;nicknameExists&#x27; =&gt; false,
  37  16  );
  38  17  
  39  18  if ($usernameRaw === &#x27;&#x27; &amp;&amp; $nicknameRaw === &#x27;&#x27;) {
  40  19      api_send_json($out);
  41  20  }
  42  21  
  43  22  if ($usernameRaw !== &#x27;&#x27;) {
  44  23      $usernameCheck = api_validate_username_value($usernameRaw);
  45  24      if (!$usernameCheck[&#x27;ok&#x27;]) {
  46  25          $out[&#x27;usernameValid&#x27;] = false;
  47  26          $out[&#x27;usernameError&#x27;] = $usernameCheck[&#x27;error&#x27;];
  48  27          api_send_json($out);
  49  28      }
  50  29      $usernameRaw = $usernameCheck[&#x27;value&#x27;];
  51  30      $out[&#x27;usernameValid&#x27;] = true;
  52  31  }
  53  32  
  54  33  if ($nicknameRaw !== &#x27;&#x27;) {

 131     3  function api_config()
 132     4  {
 133     5      static $config = null;
 134     6      if ($config !== null) {

 137     9

 140    12      if (!is_file($configPath)) {
 141    13          $samplePath = $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . &#x27;config.sample.php&#x27;;
 142    14          $sample = is_file($samplePath) ? require $samplePath : array();
 143    15          if (!is_array($sample)) {
 144    16              $sample = array();
 145    17          }
 146    18          $sample[&#x27;_missing_config&#x27;] = true;
 147    19          $config = $sample;

 149    21      }

 151    23      try {
 152    24          $loaded = require $configPath;

 154    26          api_send_json(array(
 155    27              &#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false,
 156    28              &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;config.php load failed&#x27;,
 157    29              &#x27;detail&#x27; =&gt; $e-&gt;getMessage(),
 158    30          ), 500);
 159    31      }

 161    33      if (!is_array($loaded)) {

 163    35      }

 165    37      $loaded[&#x27;_missing_config&#x27;] = false;
 166    38      $config = $loaded;
 167    39      return $config;
 168    40  }

 170    42  function api_set_status($status)
 171    43  {
 172    44      if (function_exists(&#x27;http_response_code&#x27;)) {
 173    45          http_response_code($status);
 174    46          return;
 175    47      }
 176    48  
 177    49      $messages = array(
 178    50          200 =&gt; &#x27;OK&#x27;,
 179    51          204 =&gt; &#x27;No Content&#x27;,
 180    52          400 =&gt; &#x27;Bad Request&#x27;,
 181    53          401 =&gt; &#x27;Unauthorized&#x27;,
 182    54          405 =&gt; &#x27;Method Not Allowed&#x27;,
 183    55          500 =&gt; &#x27;Internal Server Error&#x27;,
 184    56      );
 185    57      $text = isset($messages[$status]) ? $messages[$status] : &#x27;HTTP Error&#x27;;
 186    58      header(&#x27;HTTP/1.1 &#x27; . $status . &#x27; &#x27; . $text);
 187    59  }

 189    61  function api_send_json($payload, $status = 200)
 190    62  {

 193    65      header(&#x27;Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate&#x27;);
 194    66      $flags = 0;
 195    67      if (defined(&#x27;JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE&#x27;)) {
 196    68          $flags |= JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE;
 197    69      }
 198    70      if (defined(&#x27;JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES&#x27;)) {
 199    71          $flags |= JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES;
 200    72      }
 201    73      if ($flags &gt; 0) {
 202    74          echo json_encode($payload, $flags);
 203    75      } else {

 205    77      }
 206    78      exit;
 207    79  }

 312   184  function api_login_rate_limit_prune($failures, $windowSeconds)
 313   185  {
 314   186      $cutoff = time() - (int)$windowSeconds;
 315   187      $kept = array();
 316   188      foreach ($failures as $ts) {
 317   189          $ts = (int)$ts;
 318   190          if ($ts &gt;= $cutoff) {
 319   191              $kept[] = $ts;
 320   192          }
 321   193      }
 322   194      return $kept;
 323   195  }

 670   542  {

 680   552      try {

 682   554              &#x27;SELECT id, username, nickname FROM users WHERE username = :username LIMIT 1&#x27;
 683   555          );
 684   556          $stmt-&gt;execute(array(&#x27;:username&#x27; =&gt; $admin[&#x27;username&#x27;]));
 685   557          $user = $stmt-&gt;fetch();

 688   560      }

 691   563          try {
 692   564              $upd = $pdo-&gt;prepare(

 694   566              );

 696   568                  &#x27;:password_hash&#x27; =&gt; $admin[&#x27;password_hash&#x27;],
 697   569                  &#x27;:nickname&#x27; =&gt; $admin[&#x27;nickname&#x27;],

 702   574          }

 704   576              &#x27;id&#x27; =&gt; (int)$user[&#x27;id&#x27;],
 705   577              &#x27;username&#x27; =&gt; (string)$user[&#x27;username&#x27;],

 707   579          );
 708   580      }
 709   581  
 710   582      try {

 713   585          );
 714   586          $ins-&gt;execute(array(
 715   587              &#x27;:username&#x27; =&gt; $admin[&#x27;username&#x27;],
 716   588              &#x27;:nickname&#x27; =&gt; $admin[&#x27;nickname&#x27;],
 717   589              &#x27;:password_hash&#x27; =&gt; $admin[&#x27;password_hash&#x27;],
 718   590          ));
 719   591      } catch (Exception $e) {
 720   592          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;login failed&#x27;), 500);
 721   593      }
 722   594  
 723   595      return array(
 724   596          &#x27;id&#x27; =&gt; (int)$pdo-&gt;lastInsertId(),

 741   613  function api_fetch_json_url($url)
 742   614  {
 743   615      $raw = null;
 744   616  
 745   617      if (function_exists(&#x27;curl_init&#x27;)) {
 746   618          $ch = curl_init($url);
 747   619          curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
 748   620          curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 7);
 749   621          curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
 750   622          curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, array(&#x27;Accept: application/json&#x27;));
 751   623          $curlRaw = curl_exec($ch);
 752   624          if (is_string($curlRaw) &amp;&amp; $curlRaw !== &#x27;&#x27;) {
 753   625              $raw = $curlRaw;
 754   626          }
 755   627          curl_close($ch);
 756   628      }
 757   629  
 758   630      if (!is_string($raw) || $raw === &#x27;&#x27;) {
 759   631          $context = stream_context_create(array(
 760   632              &#x27;http&#x27; =&gt; array(
 761   633                  &#x27;method&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;GET&#x27;,
 762   634                  &#x27;timeout&#x27; =&gt; 7,
 763   635                  &#x27;header&#x27; =&gt; &quot;Accept: application/json\r\n&quot;,
 764   636              ),
 765   637              &#x27;ssl&#x27; =&gt; array(
 766   638                  &#x27;verify_peer&#x27; =&gt; true,
 767   639                  &#x27;verify_peer_name&#x27; =&gt; true,
 768   640              ),
 769   641          ));
 770   642          $raw = @file_get_contents($url, false, $context);
 771   643      }
 772   644  
 773   645      if (!is_string($raw) || $raw === &#x27;&#x27;) {
 774   646          return null;
 775   647      }
 776   648      $data = json_decode($raw, true);
 777   649      return is_array($data) ? $data : null;
 778   650  }

 780   652  function api_verify_google_id_token($credential)
 781   653  {
 782   654      $credential = trim((string)$credential);
 783   655      if ($credential === &#x27;&#x27;) {
 784   656          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;google credential is required&#x27;), 400);
 785   657      }
 786   658  
 787   659      $url = &#x27;https://oauth2.googleapis.com/tokeninfo?id_token=&#x27; . rawurlencode($credential);
 788   660      $payload = api_fetch_json_url($url);
 789   661      if (!is_array($payload)) {
 790   662          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;google token verification failed&#x27;), 401);
 791   663      }
 792   664      if (!empty($payload[&#x27;error_description&#x27;])) {
 793   665          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; (string)$payload[&#x27;error_description&#x27;]), 401);
 794   666      }
 795   667  
 796   668      $aud = isset($payload[&#x27;aud&#x27;]) ? trim((string)$payload[&#x27;aud&#x27;]) : &#x27;&#x27;;
 797   669      $iss = isset($payload[&#x27;iss&#x27;]) ? trim((string)$payload[&#x27;iss&#x27;]) : &#x27;&#x27;;
 798   670      $sub = isset($payload[&#x27;sub&#x27;]) ? trim((string)$payload[&#x27;sub&#x27;]) : &#x27;&#x27;;
 799   671  
 800   672      if ($aud !== api_oauth_google_client_id()) {
 801   673          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;invalid google audience&#x27;), 401);
 802   674      }
 803   675      if ($iss !== &#x27;accounts.google.com&#x27; &amp;&amp; $iss !== &#x27;https://accounts.google.com&#x27;) {
 804   676          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;invalid google issuer&#x27;), 401);
 805   677      }
 806   678      if ($sub === &#x27;&#x27;) {
 807   679          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;invalid google subject&#x27;), 401);
 808   680      }
 809   681  
 810   682      return array(
 811   683          &#x27;sub&#x27; =&gt; $sub,
 812   684          &#x27;email&#x27; =&gt; isset($payload[&#x27;email&#x27;]) ? (string)$payload[&#x27;email&#x27;] : &#x27;&#x27;,
 813   685          &#x27;name&#x27; =&gt; isset($payload[&#x27;name&#x27;]) ? (string)$payload[&#x27;name&#x27;] : &#x27;&#x27;,
 814   686      );
 815   687  }

 840   712  function api_pdo()

 842   714      $config = api_config();

 845   717      }
 846   718  
 847   719      if (!class_exists(&#x27;PDO&#x27;)) {
 848   720          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;PDO extension is not enabled&#x27;), 500);
 849   721      }

 852   724      foreach (array(&#x27;host&#x27;, &#x27;name&#x27;, &#x27;user&#x27;) as $key) {
 853   725          if (empty($db[$key])) {

 855   727          }

 857   729  
 858   730      $charset = isset($db[&#x27;charset&#x27;]) ? $db[&#x27;charset&#x27;] : &#x27;utf8mb4&#x27;;
 859   731      $dsn = sprintf(
 860   732          &#x27;mysql:host=%s;dbname=%s;charset=%s&#x27;,
 861   733          (string)$db[&#x27;host&#x27;],
 862   734          (string)$db[&#x27;name&#x27;],

 864   736      );
 865   737  
 866   738      try {
 867   739          $drivers = method_exists(&#x27;PDO&#x27;, &#x27;getAvailableDrivers&#x27;) ? PDO::getAvailableDrivers() : array();
 868   740          if (is_array($drivers) &amp;&amp; !in_array(&#x27;mysql&#x27;, $drivers, true)) {
 869   741              api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;pdo_mysql driver is not enabled&#x27;), 500);
 870   742          }
 871   743  
 872   744          return new PDO($dsn, (string)$db[&#x27;user&#x27;], (string)(isset($db[&#x27;pass&#x27;]) ? $db[&#x27;pass&#x27;] : &#x27;&#x27;), array(
 873   745              PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE =&gt; PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
 874   746              PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE =&gt; PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
 875   747              PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES =&gt; false,
 876   748          ));
 877   749      } catch (Exception $e) {
 878   750          api_send_json(array(&#x27;ok&#x27; =&gt; false, &#x27;error&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;database connection failed&#x27;), 500);
 879   751      }
 880   752  }

 882   754  function api_valid_date($date)

4001    73  function normalizeDateKey(value) {
4002    74    const match = String(value || &#x27;&#x27;).trim().match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);
4003    75    if (!match) return &#x27;&#x27;;
4004    76    const key = match[1];
4005    77    const parts = key.split(&#x27;-&#x27;).map(Number);
4006    78    if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some((n) =&gt; Number.isNaN(n))) return &#x27;&#x27;;
4007    79    const [y, mo, day] = parts;
4008    80    const dt = new Date(y, mo - 1, day);
4009    81    if (dt.getFullYear() !== y || dt.getMonth() !== mo - 1 || dt.getDate() !== day) return &#x27;&#x27;;
4010    82    return key;
4011    83  }

4177   249    async function fetchApiJson(endpoint, options = {}) {
4178   250      let lastStatus;
4179   251      let lastData = null;
4180   252  
4181   253      for (const url of getApiFetchUrlCandidates(endpoint)) {
4182   254        try {
4183   255          const r = await fetch(url, {
4184   256            cache: &#x27;no-store&#x27;,
4185   257            ...options,
4186   258            credentials: options.credentials ?? &#x27;include&#x27;
4187   259          });
4188   260          let data = null;
4189   261          try {
4190   262            data = await r.json();
4191   263          } catch {
4192   264            data = null;
4193   265          }
4194   266          lastStatus = r.status;
4195   267          if (data &amp;&amp; typeof data === &#x27;object&#x27;) {
4196   268            lastData = data;
4197   269          }
4198   270          if (r.status === 401) {
4199   271            if (isAuthenticated) {
4200   272              handleUnauthorized();
4201   273              return { ok: false, unauthorized: true, data };
4202   274            }
4203   275            return { ok: false, status: r.status, data };
4204   276          }
4205   277          if (!r.ok) {
4206   278            if (r.status === 409 || r.status === 400) {
4207   279              return {
4208   280                ok: false,
4209   281                status: r.status,
4210   282                data: data &amp;&amp; typeof data === &#x27;object&#x27; ? data : {},
4211   283              };
4212   284            }
4213   285            if (r.status === 404) {
4214   286              if (data &amp;&amp; (data.error || data.message || data.ok === false)) {
4215   287                return { ok: false, status: r.status, data };
4216   288              }
4217   289              continue;
4218   290            }
4219   291            if (!data) continue;
4220   292            return { ok: false, status: r.status, data };
4221   293          }
4222   294          if (!data || typeof data !== &#x27;object&#x27;) continue;
4223   295          return { ok: true, data };
4224   296        } catch {
4225   297          /* 다음 후보 */
4226   298        }
4227   299      }
4228   300      return {
4229   301        ok: false,
4230   302        status: lastStatus,
4231   303        data: lastData &amp;&amp; typeof lastData === &#x27;object&#x27; ? lastData : null,
4232   304      };
4233   305    }

4472   544      const set = getCalendarDatesSet();

4474   546      const y = calendarView.getFullYear();

4476   548      const monthPrefix = `${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, &#x27;0&#x27;)}`;

4542   614    function parseNumberedSection(content, title, state) {
4543   615      const entries = [];
4544   616      const start = content.indexOf(title);
4545   617      if (start &lt; 0) return entries;
4546   618      const rest = content.slice(start + title.length);
4547   619      const next = rest.search(/\n---\s*[^-]+?\s*---/);
4548   620      const section = next &gt;= 0 ? rest.slice(0, next) : rest;
4549   621      section.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line) =&gt; {
4550   622        const m = line.trim().match(/^\d+\.\s*(.+)$/);
4551   623        if (m &amp;&amp; m[1]) {
4552   624          entries.push({ text: m[1].trim(), state });
4553   625        }
4554   626      });
4555   627      return entries;
4556   628    }

4558   630    function parseJournalContent(content) {
4559   631      let raw = String(content || &#x27;&#x27;).trim();
4560   632      if (!raw) return [];
4561   633      if (raw.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) raw = raw.slice(1);
4562   634  
4563   635      try {
4564   636        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
4565   637        if (parsed &amp;&amp; parsed.entries != null) {
4566   638          const list = Array.isArray(parsed.entries)
4567   639            ? parsed.entries
4568   640            : Object.values(parsed.entries);
4569   641          return list
4570   642            .map((entry) =&gt; ({
4571   643              text: String(entry.text || entry.task || &#x27;&#x27;).trim(),
4572   644              state: normalizeJournalState(entry.state || &#x27;pending&#x27;)
4573   645            }))
4574   646            .filter((entry) =&gt; entry.text);
4575   647        }
4576   648      } catch {
4577   649        /* 기존 텍스트 포맷 */
4578   650      }
4579   651  
4580   652      return [
4581   653        ...parseNumberedSection(raw, &#x27;--- 완료한 작업 ---&#x27;, &#x27;completed&#x27;),
4582   654        ...parseNumberedSection(raw, &#x27;--- 진행중 작업 ---&#x27;, &#x27;in-progress&#x27;),
4583   655        ...parseNumberedSection(raw, &#x27;--- 시작전 작업 ---&#x27;, &#x27;pending&#x27;),
4584   656        ...parseNumberedSection(raw, &#x27;--- 미완료 작업 ---&#x27;, &#x27;pending&#x27;)
4585   657      ];
4586   658    }

4592   664        date: dateKey,

4594   666        entries: entries
4595   667          .map((entry) =&gt; ({
4596   668            text: String(entry.text || &#x27;&#x27;).trim(),
4597   669            state: normalizeJournalState(entry.state || &#x27;pending&#x27;)
4598   670          }))
4599   671          .filter((entry) =&gt; entry.text)
4600   672      }, null, 2);
4601   673    }

 24  <body>
 25  <h1>기술명세 · 하루일과</h1>
 26  <p><strong>하루일과</strong>는 관리자 로그인 후 캘린더에서 <strong>과거·오늘</strong> 날짜별 할일을 CRUD하고 MySQL <code>journals</code>에 JSON으로 저장하는 SPA다. 프론트는 바닐라 HTML/CSS/JS(Aurora UI), 백엔드는 닷홈 PHP/MySQL <code>api/*.php</code>다.</p>
 27  <p>함수·시그니처 상세는 <code>code-reference.pdf</code>에, 파일 구간 해설은 <code>codebook.pdf</code>에 둔다. 본 묶음은 요구사항부터 시험 명세까지의 <strong>기술명세</strong>다.</p>
 28  <h2>읽는 순서</h2>
 29  <ol><li>요구사항 명세</li><li>유스케이스</li><li>자료 흐름도 (DFD)</li><li>자료 사전 (DD)</li><li>화면 흐름</li><li>프로세스 명세</li><li>상태 전이</li><li>구조도</li><li>시험 명세</li></ol>
 30  <h2>행위자</h2>
 31  <ul><li><strong>관리자</strong>: <code>config.php</code>의 admin 계정으로 로그인해 할일을 기록한다.</li><li><strong>브라우저</strong>: SPA UI, <code>fetch</code>로 JSON API 호출, localStorage로 테마·캘린더 ✓ 보조 캐시.</li><li><strong>PHP API</strong>: 세션·검증·PDO로 MySQL 접근.</li><li><strong>작성자</strong>: 저장소에서 <code>doc-publication/build_all.py</code>로 PDF를 생성한다.</li></ul>
 32  <h1>요구사항 명세</h1>
 33  <h2>기능 요구 (FR)</h2>
 34  <p>| ID | 요구 | 근거 | |----|------|------| | FR-01 | 관리자만 로그인 가능 (<code>config.php</code> admin) | <code>api/login.php</code>, 회원가입 403 | | FR-02 | 로그인·세션 확인·로그아웃 | <code>login.php</code>, <code>session.php</code>, <code>logout.php</code> | | FR-03 | 캘린더에 DB journal 존재 날 ✓ 표시 | <code>list-dates.php</code>, <code>app.js</code> | | FR-04 | 과거·오늘 날짜 클릭 시 할일 모달 CRUD | <code>app.js</code>, <code>save-journal.php</code> | | FR-05 | 미래 날짜 비활성 | <code>app.js</code> 날짜 검증 | | FR-06 | 할일 상태: pending / in-progress / completed | journal JSON <code>entries[]</code> | | FR-07 | 빈 날 저장 시 journal·✓ 제거 | <code>save-journal.php</code> | | FR-08 | DB 날짜 새로고침 버튼 | <code>list-dates.php</code> | | FR-09 | 프로필 닉네임·비밀번호 변경 | <code>profile.html</code>, <code>update-profile.php</code> | | FR-10 | 회원 탈퇴(관리자 계정 차단) | <code>delete-account.php</code> | | FR-11 | 다크 모드 토글·유지 | <code>haru_theme</code>, <code>styles.css</code> |</p>
 35  <h2>비기능 요구 (NFR)</h2>
 36  <p>| ID | 요구 | |----|------| | NFR-01 | 닷홈 HTTPS 배포, 세션 쿠키 Secure 정책 (<code>api/db.php</code>) | | NFR-02 | 반응형(1280/960/768/640px), 모바일 가로 스크롤 방지 | | NFR-03 | 로그인 실패 메시지 통일(계정 존재 추측 방지) | | NFR-04 | IP 기준 로그인 rate limit (<code>api/_security_data/</code>) | | NFR-05 | <code>api/config.php</code> 저장소 미포함, FTP 시 서버에만 배치 |</p>
 37  <h2>제외·레거시</h2>
 38  <ul><li><code>api/state.php</code>, <code>milestones</code>/<code>daily_tasks</code> 테이블: 마일스톤 workspace 레거시(현행 UX는 journal 중심).</li><li><code>register.html</code> / <code>register.php</code>: 회원가입 비활성.</li></ul>
 39  <h1>유스케이스</h1>
 40  <h2>UC-01 로그인 성공</h2>
 41  <ul><li><strong>주체</strong>: 관리자</li><li><strong>전제</strong>: 유효한 admin 자격, rate limit 미초과</li><li><strong>흐름</strong>: index 로그인 폼 → <code>POST login.php</code> → 세션 생성 → 캘린더 UI 표시</li><li><strong>결과</strong>: <code>session.php</code>가 logged-in 반환</li></ul>
 42  <h2>UC-02 로그인 실패</h2>
 43  <ul><li><strong>흐름</strong>: 잘못된 비밀번호 → 동일 오류 JSON → 실패 IP 기록</li><li><strong>429</strong>: 짧은 시간 다수 실패 → rate limit 응답</li></ul>
 44  <h2>UC-03 날짜별 할일 저장</h2>
 45  <ul><li><strong>전제</strong>: 로그인, 날짜 ≤ 오늘</li><li><strong>흐름</strong>: 날짜 클릭 → 모달 편집 → 저장 → <code>POST save-journal.php</code></li><li><strong>결과</strong>: <code>journals</code> upsert 또는 삭제, 캘린더 ✓ 갱신</li></ul>
 46  <h2>UC-04 journal 조회</h2>
 47  <ul><li><strong>흐름</strong>: 날짜 선택 → <code>GET journal.php?date=</code> → 모달에 entries 렌더</li></ul>
 48  <h2>UC-05 로그아웃</h2>
 49  <ul><li><strong>흐름</strong>: 로그아웃 버튼 → <code>POST logout.php</code> → 로그인 화면</li></ul>
 50  <h2>UC-06 프로필 수정</h2>
 51  <ul><li><strong>흐름</strong>: profile.html → <code>GET profile.php</code> → 폼 수정 → <code>POST update-profile.php</code></li></ul>
 52  <h2>UC-07 DB 날짜 새로고침</h2>
 53  <ul><li><strong>흐름</strong>: 헤더 버튼 → <code>GET list-dates.php</code> → localStorage·캘린더 ✓ 재계산</li></ul>
 54  <h1>자료 흐름도 (DFD)</h1>
 55  <p>외부 실체: <strong>관리자(브라우저)</strong>, <strong>MySQL</strong>, <strong>작성자(빌드)</strong>.</p>
 56  <h2>배경도</h2>
 57  <figure class="chart"><img src="specs/diagrams/56111043a28d.png" alt="차트" /></figure>
 58  <h2>레벨 1</h2>
 59  <figure class="chart"><img src="specs/diagrams/8f58b98dd764.png" alt="차트" /></figure>
 60  <h2>프로세스 요약</h2>
 61  <p>| 프로세스 | 입력 | 출력 | |----------|------|------| | P1 | username, password | 세션 쿠키, JSON ok | | P2 | date, entries JSON | journals 행 upsert/delete | | P3 | user_id | journal_date 목록 → UI ✓ |</p>
 62  <h1>자료 사전 (DD)</h1>
 63  <h2>users</h2>
 64  <p>| 필드 | 타입 | 설명 | |------|------|------| | id | INT PK | 사용자 ID | | username | VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE | 로그인 ID | | nickname | VARCHAR(50) | 표시 이름 | | password_hash | VARCHAR(255) | bcrypt 등 해시 |</p>
 65  <h2>journals</h2>
 66  <p>| 필드 | 타입 | 설명 | |------|------|------| | user_id | INT FK | users.id | | journal_date | DATE | YYYY-MM-DD | | content | MEDIUMTEXT | JSON 문자열 |</p>
 67  <h3>content JSON (entries)</h3>
 68  <pre class="code">{
 69    &quot;entries&quot;: [
 70      { &quot;id&quot;: &quot;uuid&quot;, &quot;text&quot;: &quot;할일&quot;, &quot;state&quot;: &quot;pending&quot; }
 71    ]
 72  }
 73  </pre>
 74  <ul><li><strong>state</strong>: <code>pending</code> | <code>in-progress</code> | <code>completed</code></li></ul>
 75  <h2>activity_dates</h2>
 76  <p>| 필드 | 설명 | |------|------| | user_id, activity_date | 기록이 있는 날(캘린더 ✓ 보조, journal과 동기화) |</p>
 77  <h2>레거시 테이블</h2>
 78  <ul><li><strong>milestones</strong>, <strong>daily_tasks</strong>: <code>state.php</code> 시대 workspace용. 스키마는 유지될 수 있으나 현행 UI는 journals 중심.</li></ul>
 79  <h2>클라이언트 키 (localStorage)</h2>
 80  <p>| 키 | 용도 | |----|------| | haru_theme | light/dark | | haru_saved_dates | ✓ 날짜 캐시 | | haru_journal_{date} | journal 본문 보조 |</p>
 81  <h1>화면 흐름</h1>
 82  <h2>index.html (SPA)</h2>
 83  <ol><li><strong>비로그인</strong>: 로그인 카드(1열, <code>--content-column-max</code>)</li><li><strong>로그인 후</strong>: 헤더(테마·DB 새로고침·프로필·로그아웃) + 캘린더</li><li><strong>날짜 클릭</strong>(과거·오늘): journal 모달 — 960px+ 3열 칸반, 미만 1열</li><li><strong>저장/닫기</strong>: API 반영 후 캘린더 ✓ 갱신</li></ol>
 84  <figure class="chart"><img src="specs/diagrams/eb2643f3ba49.png" alt="차트" /></figure>
 85  <h2>profile.html</h2>

  1  # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
  2  """소스 주석을 읽어 코드 설명 마크다운과 PDF를 만든다."""
  3  from __future__ import annotations

  9  import shutil

 14  ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
 15  DOCS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 16  MD_PATH = DOCS / "code-reference.md"
 17  HTML_PATH = DOCS / "code-reference.html"
 18  PDF_PATH = DOCS / "code-reference.pdf"

 20  ID_RE = re.compile(r"\d{7,8}")
 21  NAME_RE = re.compile("김신욱")

 23  
 24  def mask_privacy(text: str) -> str:
 25      """파일 목록에 섞인 학번과 이름을 가린다."""
 26      text = ID_RE.sub("OOOOOOOO", text)
 27      return NAME_RE.sub("OOO", text)

 34  class Doc:
 35      def __init__(self) -> None:
 36          self.blocks: list[tuple] = []
 37  
 38      def h1(self, text: str) -> None:
 39          self.blocks.append(("h1", text))
 40  
 41      def h2(self, text: str) -> None:
 42          self.blocks.append(("h2", text))
 43  
 44      def h3(self, text: str) -> None:
 45          self.blocks.append(("h3", text))
 46  
 47      def h4(self, text: str) -> None:
 48          self.blocks.append(("h4", text))
 49  
 50      def p(self, text: str) -> None:
 51          self.blocks.append(("p", text))
 52  
 53      def ul(self, items: list[str]) -> None:
 54          self.blocks.append(("ul", items))
 55  
 56      def code(self, text: str) -> None:
 57          self.blocks.append(("code", text))
 58  
 59      def render_md(self) -> str:
 60          out: list[str] = []
 61          for kind, payload in self.blocks:
 62              if kind == "h1":
 63                  out.append(f"# {payload}\n")
 64              elif kind == "h2":
 65                  out.append(f"\n## {payload}\n")
 66              elif kind == "h3":
 67                  out.append(f"\n### {payload}\n")
 68              elif kind == "h4":
 69                  out.append(f"\n#### {payload}\n")
 70              elif kind == "p":
 71                  out.append(payload + "\n")
 72              elif kind == "ul":
 73                  out.extend(f"- {item}" for item in payload)
 74                  out.append("")
 75              elif kind == "code":
 76                  out.append("```")
 77                  out.append(payload)
 78                  out.append("```\n")
 79          return "\n".join(out).strip() + "\n"
 80  
 81      def render_html(self) -> str:
 82          parts = [
 83              "<!DOCTYPE html>",
 84              '<html lang="ko">',
 85              "<head>",
 86              '<meta charset="utf-8" />',
 87              "<title>코드 설명</title>",
 88              "<style>",
 89              HTML_CSS,
 90              "</style>",
 91              "</head>",
 92              "<body>",
 93          ]
 94          first_h2 = True
 95          for kind, payload in self.blocks:
 96              if kind == "h1":
 97                  parts.append(f"<h1>{html.escape(payload)}</h1>")
 98              elif kind == "h2":
 99                  cls = "first" if first_h2 else ""
100                  first_h2 = False
101                  parts.append(f'<h2 class="{cls}">{html.escape(payload)}</h2>')
102              elif kind == "h3":
103                  parts.append(f"<h3>{html.escape(payload)}</h3>")
104              elif kind == "h4":
105                  parts.append(f"<h4>{html.escape(payload)}</h4>")
106              elif kind == "p":
107                  parts.append(f"<p>{inline_html(payload)}</p>")
108              elif kind == "ul":
109                  items = "".join(f"<li>{inline_html(item)}</li>" for item in payload)
110                  parts.append(f"<ul>{items}</ul>")
111              elif kind == "code":
112                  parts.append(f"<pre>{html.escape(payload)}</pre>")
113          parts.append("</body></html>")
114          return "\n".join(parts)

120  h1 { font-size: 22pt; margin: 0 0 0.6em; }

132  INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`")
133  BOLD = re.compile(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*")
134  
135  
136  def inline_html(text: str) -> str:
137      escaped = html.escape(text)
138      escaped = INLINE_CODE.sub(lambda m: f"<code>{m.group(1)}</code>", escaped)
139      escaped = BOLD.sub(lambda m: f"<strong>{m.group(1)}</strong>", escaped)
140      return escaped

143  def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
144      return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

146  
147  def jsdoc_before(lines: list[str], index: int) -> str:
148      if index == 0 or lines[index - 1].strip() != "*/":
149          return ""
150      start = index - 1
151      while start >= 0 and "/**" not in lines[start]:
152          start -= 1
153      if start < 0:
154          return ""
155      chunk = "\n".join(lines[start:index])
156      body_lines = []
157      for line in chunk.splitlines():
158          line = re.sub(r"^\s*/?\*+/?\s?", "", line).strip()
159          if line in ("/**", "*/", "*"):
160              continue
161          if line:
162              body_lines.append(line)
163      return "\n".join(body_lines).strip()
164  
165  
166  def split_jsdoc(doc: str) -> tuple[str, list[str], str]:
167      desc: list[str] = []
168      params: list[str] = []
169      returns = ""
170      for line in doc.splitlines():
171          param = re.match(r"@param\s+\{([^}]+)\}\s+(\S+)\s*(.*)", line)
172          ret = re.match(r"@returns?\s+\{([^}]+)\}\s*(.*)", line)
173          if param:
174              extra = f" {param.group(3)}".rstrip()
175              params.append(f"{param.group(2)}: {param.group(1)}{extra}")
176          elif ret:
177              extra = f" {ret.group(2)}".rstrip()
178              returns = f"{ret.group(1)}{extra}"
179          elif not line.startswith("@"):
180              desc.append(line)
181      return " ".join(desc).strip(), params, returns
182  
183  
184  def clip_expr(text: str, limit: int = 72) -> str:
185      text = " ".join(text.split())
186      if len(text) <= limit:
187          return text
188      return text[: limit - 1] + "…"
189  
190  
191  def py_expr(node: ast.AST | None) -> str:
192      if node is None:
193          return ""
194      try:
195          return clip_expr(ast.unparse(node))
196      except Exception:
197          return "식"
198  
199  
200  def append_py_stmt(stmt: ast.AST, depth: int, lines: list[str], limit: int) -> None:
201      if len(lines) >= limit:
202          return
203      pad = "  " * depth
204      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Expr) and isinstance(stmt.value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(stmt.value.value, str):
205          return
206      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Pass):
207          return
208      if isinstance(stmt, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
209          lines.append(f"{pad}{stmt.name} 을 정의한다")
210          return
211      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Return):
212          value = py_expr(stmt.value)
213          lines.append(f"{pad}반환 {value}" if value else f"{pad}반환")
214          return
215      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Assign):
216          targets = ", ".join(py_expr(target) for target in stmt.targets)
217          lines.append(f"{pad}{targets} ← {py_expr(stmt.value)}")
218          return
219      if isinstance(stmt, ast.AnnAssign):
220          if stmt.value is not None:
221              lines.append(f"{pad}{py_expr(stmt.target)} ← {py_expr(stmt.value)}")
222          else:
223              lines.append(f"{pad}필드 {py_expr(stmt.target)}")
224          return
225      if isinstance(stmt, ast.AugAssign):
226          lines.append(f"{pad}{py_expr(stmt.target)} ← {py_expr(stmt.target)} 연산 {py_expr(stmt.value)}")
227          return
228      if isinstance(stmt, ast.If):
229          lines.append(f"{pad}만약 {py_expr(stmt.test)}")
230          for child in stmt.body:
231              append_py_stmt(child, depth + 1, lines, limit)
232          if stmt.orelse:
233              lines.append(f"{pad}아니면")
234              for child in stmt.orelse:
235                  append_py_stmt(child, depth + 1, lines, limit)
236          return
237      if isinstance(stmt, ast.For):
238          lines.append(f"{pad}반복 {py_expr(stmt.target)} ← {py_expr(stmt.iter)}")
239          for child in stmt.body:
240              append_py_stmt(child, depth + 1, lines, limit)
241          return
242      if isinstance(stmt, ast.While):
243          lines.append(f"{pad}동안 {py_expr(stmt.test)}")
244          for child in stmt.body:
245              append_py_stmt(child, depth + 1, lines, limit)
246          return
247      if isinstance(stmt, ast.With):
248          heads = ", ".join(py_expr(item.context_expr) for item in stmt.items)
249          lines.append(f"{pad}범위 {heads}")
250          for child in stmt.body:
251              append_py_stmt(child, depth + 1, lines, limit)
252          return
253      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Try):
254          lines.append(f"{pad}시도")
255          for child in stmt.body:
256              append_py_stmt(child, depth + 1, lines, limit)
257          for handler in stmt.handlers:
258              label = py_expr(handler.type) if handler.type else "예외"
259              lines.append(f"{pad}실패 {label}")
260              for child in handler.body:
261                  append_py_stmt(child, depth + 1, lines, limit)
262          return
263      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Raise):
264          lines.append(f"{pad}중단 {py_expr(stmt.exc)}".rstrip())
265          return
266      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Continue):
267          lines.append(f"{pad}다음 반복")
268          return
269      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Break):
270          lines.append(f"{pad}반복 종료")
271          return
272      if isinstance(stmt, ast.Delete):
273          lines.append(f"{pad}삭제 {', '.join(py_expr(target) for target in stmt.targets)}")
274          return
275      if isinstance(stmt, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
276          lines.append(f"{pad}모듈을 불러온다")
277          return
278      try:
279          lines.append(f"{pad}{clip_expr(ast.unparse(stmt))}")
280      except Exception:
281          lines.append(f"{pad}문장을 실행한다")
282  
283  
284  def py_pseudocode(node: ast.AST) -> str:
285      lines: list[str] = []
286      if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
287          lines.append(f"클래스 {node.name}")
288          for stmt in node.body:
289              if isinstance(stmt, ast.Expr) and isinstance(stmt.value, ast.Constant):
290                  continue
291              if isinstance(stmt, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
292                  lines.append(f"  메서드 {stmt.name}")
293              elif isinstance(stmt, ast.AnnAssign):
294                  lines.append(f"  필드 {py_expr(stmt.target)}")
295              elif isinstance(stmt, ast.Assign):
296                  targets = ", ".join(py_expr(target) for target in stmt.targets)
297                  lines.append(f"  {targets} ← {py_expr(stmt.value)}")
298              else:
299                  append_py_stmt(stmt, 1, lines, 40)
300          return "\n".join(lines)
301      for stmt in getattr(node, "body", []):
302          append_py_stmt(stmt, 0, lines, 40)
303      if len(lines) >= 40:
304          lines.append("…")
305      return "\n".join(lines) if lines else "수행할 문장이 없다"
306  
307  
308  def js_body_lines(lines: list[str], index: int) -> list[str]:
309      blob = "\n".join(lines[index:])
310      start = blob.find("{")
311      if start < 0:
312          return []
313      depth = 0
314      end = start
315      for pos in range(start, len(blob)):
316          char = blob[pos]
317          if char == "{":
318              depth += 1
319          elif char == "}":
320              depth -= 1
321              if depth == 0:
322                  end = pos
323                  break
324      body = blob[start + 1 : end]
325      return body.splitlines()
326  
327  
328  def js_pseudocode(lines: list[str], index: int) -> str:
329      body = js_body_lines(lines, index)
330      out: list[str] = []
331      depth = 0
332      skipping = False
333      skip_depth = 0
334      for raw in body:
335          if len(out) >= 40:
336              break
337          line = raw.strip()
338          if not line or line.startswith("//") or line.startswith("/*") or line.startswith("*"):
339              if "{" in line or "}" in line:
340                  pass
341              else:
342                  continue
343          if skipping:
344              skip_depth += line.count("{") - line.count("}")
345              if skip_depth <= 0:
346                  skipping = False
347              continue
348          nested = re.match(r"function\s+(\w+)\s*\(", line)
349          if nested:
350              out.append(f"{'  ' * depth}{nested.group(1)} 을 정의한다")
351              skip_depth = line.count("{") - line.count("}")
352              if skip_depth > 0:
353                  skipping = True
354              continue
355          open_count = line.count("{")
356          close_count = line.count("}")
357          code = re.sub(r"\s*\{\s*$", "", line).rstrip(";").strip()
358          if re.match(r"\}?\s*else\s+if\b", code):
359              code = re.sub(r"^\}?\s*", "", code)
360          elif re.match(r"\}?\s*else\b", code):
361              code = "else"
362          pad = "  " * depth
363          if code.startswith("if ("):
364              out.append(f"{pad}만약 {clip_expr(code[3:].strip(' ()'))}")
365          elif code.startswith("} else if (") or code.startswith("else if ("):
366              cond = code.split("(", 1)[1].rsplit(")", 1)[0]
367              out.append(f"{pad}아니면 만약 {clip_expr(cond)}")
368          elif code in ("else", "} else"):
369              out.append(f"{pad}아니면")
370          elif code.startswith("for ") or code.startswith("for("):
371              out.append(f"{pad}반복 {clip_expr(code)}")
372          elif code.startswith("while"):
373              out.append(f"{pad}동안 {clip_expr(code)}")
374          elif code.startswith("return"):
375              value = code[6:].strip()
376              out.append(f"{pad}반환 {clip_expr(value)}" if value else f"{pad}반환")
377          elif re.match(r"(?:var|let|const)\s+", code):
378              out.append(f"{pad}{clip_expr(re.sub(r'^(?:var|let|const)\s+', '', code).replace(' = ', ' ← ', 1))}")
379          elif code.startswith("try"):
380              out.append(f"{pad}시도")
381          elif code.startswith("catch"):
382              out.append(f"{pad}실패")
383          elif code.startswith("throw"):
384              out.append(f"{pad}중단 {clip_expr(code[5:].strip())}")
385          elif code and not re.fullmatch(r"[\s{}\[\]();,]+", code):
386              out.append(f"{pad}{clip_expr(code)}")
387          depth += open_count - close_count
388          if depth < 0:
389              depth = 0
390      if len(out) >= 40:
391          out.append("…")
392      return "\n".join(out) if out else "수행할 문장이 없다"
393

395  def parse_js(path: Path) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]:
396      lines = read_text(path).splitlines()
397      file_doc = ""
398      if lines and lines[0].strip().startswith("/**"):
399          end = 0
400          while end < len(lines) and "*/" not in lines[end]:
401              end += 1
402          file_doc = jsdoc_before(lines, end + 1)
403      symbols = []
404      for index, line in enumerate(lines):
405          match = re.match(r"\s*function\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)", line)
406          if not match:
407              continue
408          doc = jsdoc_before(lines, index)
409          desc, params, returns = split_jsdoc(doc)
410          if not params and match.group(2).strip():
411              params = [part.strip() for part in match.group(2).split(",") if part.strip()]
412          symbols.append(
413              {
414                  "name": match.group(1),
415                  "signature": f"function {match.group(1)}({match.group(2).strip()})",
416                  "line": index + 1,
417                  "desc": desc,
418                  "params": params,
419                  "returns": returns,
420                  "pseudo": js_pseudocode(lines, index),
421              }
422          )
423      return file_doc, symbols
424  
425  
426  def annotation(node: ast.AST | None) -> str:
427      if node is None:
428          return ""
429      return ast.unparse(node)
430  
431  
432  def py_params(node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef) -> list[str]:
433      args = node.args
434      names: list[ast.arg] = list(args.posonlyargs) + list(args.args)
435      default_start = len(names) - len(args.defaults)
436      parts: list[str] = []
437      for index, arg in enumerate(names):
438          if arg.arg in ("self", "cls"):
439              continue
440          label = arg.arg
441          ann = annotation(arg.annotation)
442          if ann:
443              label += f": {ann}"
444          if index >= default_start:
445              default = ast.unparse(args.defaults[index - default_start])
446              label += f" = {default}"
447          parts.append(label)
448      if args.vararg:
449          label = "*" + args.vararg.arg
450          ann = annotation(args.vararg.annotation)
451          parts.append(f"{label}: {ann}" if ann else label)
452      for arg, default in zip(args.kwonlyargs, args.kw_defaults):
453          label = arg.arg
454          ann = annotation(arg.annotation)
455          if ann:
456              label += f": {ann}"
457          if default is not None:
458              label += f" = {ast.unparse(default)}"
459          parts.append(label)
460      if args.kwarg:
461          label = "**" + args.kwarg.arg
462          ann = annotation(args.kwarg.annotation)
463          parts.append(f"{label}: {ann}" if ann else label)
464      return parts
465  
466  
467  def py_signature(node: ast.AST) -> str:
468      if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
469          bases = ", ".join(ast.unparse(base) for base in node.bases)
470          return f"class {node.name}({bases})" if bases else f"class {node.name}"
471      assert isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
472      prefix = "async def" if isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) else "def"
473      ret = annotation(node.returns)
474      tail = f" -> {ret}" if ret else ""
475      return f"{prefix} {node.name}({ast.unparse(node.args)}){tail}"
476  
477  
478  def iter_py_symbols(node: ast.AST, prefix: str = ""):
479      for child in getattr(node, "body", []):
480          if isinstance(child, ast.ClassDef):
481              name = f"{prefix}{child.name}"
482              yield name, child
483              yield from iter_py_symbols(child, name + ".")
484          elif isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
485              name = f"{prefix}{child.name}"
486              yield name, child
487              yield from iter_py_symbols(child, name + ".")
488  
489  
490  def parse_py(path: Path) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]:
491      tree = ast.parse(read_text(path))
492      file_doc = ast.get_docstring(tree) or ""
493      symbols = []
494      for name, node in iter_py_symbols(tree):
495          desc = ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
496          params: list[str] = []
497          returns = ""
498          if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
499              params = py_params(node)
500              returns = annotation(node.returns)
501          symbols.append(
502              {
503                  "name": name,
504                  "signature": py_signature(node),
505                  "line": node.lineno,
506                  "desc": " ".join(desc.split()),
507                  "params": params,
508                  "returns": returns,
509                  "pseudo": py_pseudocode(node),
510              }
511          )
512      return file_doc, symbols

537  def file_comment(path: Path) -> str:
538      text = read_text(path)
539      if path.suffix.lower() == ".html":
540          match = re.match(r"<!--\s*(.*?)\s*-->", text, re.S)
541          return " ".join(match.group(1).split()) if match else ""
542      if path.suffix.lower() == ".css":
543          if text.startswith("@charset"):
544              text = text.split("\n", 1)[1]
545          match = re.search(r"/\*\s*(.*?)\s*\*/", text, re.S)
546          return " ".join(match.group(1).split()) if match else ""
547      return ""

571  def data_role(path: Path) -> str:
572      name = path.name
573      suffix = path.suffix.lower()
574      if suffix in {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".webp", ".bmp"}:
575          return "학습·과제 화면 캡처 또는 도표"
576      if "과제분류하기" in path.parts:
577          return "과제 제출 원본"
578      if "독서" in name:
579          return "독서 노트"
580      if "수강" in name or "영상" in name:
581          return "수강 노트"
582      if suffix == ".hwpx":
583          return "한글 문서 원본. 요약 빌드에서는 제외한다"
584      return "학습 기록 원본"

587  def is_generated_data(path: Path) -> bool:
588      parts = set(path.parts)
589      if parts & {"obj", "bin", "My Project"}:
590          return True
591      if path.name.endswith(".Designer.vb"):
592          return True
593      if path.suffix.lower() in {".exe", ".dll", ".pdb", ".cache", ".suo", ".user"}:
594          return True
595      return False

598  def collect_originals() -> dict[str, list[str]]:
599      data = ROOT / "study_note_record_organization" / "data"
600      grouped: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
601      if not data.is_dir():
602          return grouped
603      for path in sorted(data.rglob("*")):
604          if not path.is_file() or is_generated_data(path):
605              continue
606          if ".vs" in path.parts or path.suffix.lower() in CODE_SUFFIXES:
607              continue
608          label = mask_privacy(f"{rel(path)} — {data_role(path)}")
609          grouped.setdefault(path.suffix.lower() or "(확장자 없음)", []).append(label)
610      return grouped

756  def find_browser() -> Path | None:
757      local = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")
758      candidates = [
759          Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
760          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
761          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"),
762          Path(local) / "Google" / "Chrome" / "Application" / "chrome.exe",
763      ]
764      for candidate in candidates:
765          if candidate.is_file():
766              return candidate
767      return None
768  
769  
770  def write_pdf(html_path: Path, pdf_path: Path) -> None:
771      browser = find_browser()
772      if browser is None:
773          raise SystemExit("PDF로 인쇄할 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
774      if pdf_path.exists():
775          pdf_path.unlink()
776      profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="code-ref-pdf-"))
777      url = html_path.resolve().as_uri()
778      command = [
779          str(browser),
780          "--headless=new",
781          "--disable-gpu",
782          "--no-first-run",
783          "--no-pdf-header-footer",
784          f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
785          f"--print-to-pdf={pdf_path.resolve()}",
786          url,
787      ]
788      try:
789          subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=120)
790      finally:
791          shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
792      if not pdf_path.is_file() or pdf_path.stat().st_size < 1000:
793          raise SystemExit(f"PDF가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {pdf_path}")
794  
795  
796  def main() -> None:
797      doc = build()
798      MD_PATH.write_text(doc.render_md(), encoding="utf-8")
799      HTML_PATH.write_text(doc.render_html(), encoding="utf-8")
800      write_pdf(HTML_PATH, PDF_PATH)
801      print(f"Wrote {MD_PATH}")
802      print(f"Wrote {HTML_PATH}")
803      print(f"Wrote {PDF_PATH} ({PDF_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
804  
805  
806  if __name__ == "__main__":
807      main()

  1  # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
  2  """코드북 마크다운을 이어 한글 PDF로 만든다."""
  3  from __future__ import annotations
  4  
  5  import html
  6  import os
  7  import re
  8  import shutil
  9  import subprocess
 10  import tempfile
 11  from pathlib import Path
 12  
 13  ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 14  CHAPTERS = ROOT / "codebook"
 15  MD_PATH = ROOT / "codebook.md"
 16  HTML_PATH = ROOT / "codebook.html"
 17  PDF_PATH = ROOT / "codebook.pdf"
 18  
 19  INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`")
 20  BOLD = re.compile(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*")
 21  
 22  
 23  def inline(text: str) -> str:
 24      escaped = html.escape(text)
 25      escaped = INLINE_CODE.sub(lambda match: f"<code>{match.group(1)}</code>", escaped)
 26      escaped = BOLD.sub(lambda match: f"<strong>{match.group(1)}</strong>", escaped)
 27      return escaped
 28  
 29  
 30  def markdown_to_html(text: str) -> str:
 31      lines = text.splitlines()
 32      parts: list[str] = []
 33      index = 0
 34      while index < len(lines):
 35          line = lines[index]
 36          if line.startswith("```"):
 37              body: list[str] = []
 38              index += 1
 39              while index < len(lines) and not lines[index].startswith("```"):
 40                  body.append(lines[index])
 41                  index += 1
 42              index += 1
 43              parts.append(f'<pre class="code">{html.escape(chr(10).join(body))}</pre>')
 44              continue
 45          if not line.strip():
 46              index += 1
 47              continue
 48          if line.startswith("#"):
 49              level = len(line) - len(line.lstrip("#"))
 50              level = min(max(level, 1), 4)
 51              title = line[level:].strip()
 52              parts.append(f"<h{level}>{inline(title)}</h{level}>")
 53              index += 1
 54              continue
 55          if line.startswith("- "):
 56              items: list[str] = []
 57              while index < len(lines) and lines[index].startswith("- "):
 58                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(lines[index][2:].strip())}</li>")
 59                  index += 1
 60              parts.append("<ul>" + "".join(items) + "</ul>")
 61              continue
 62          if re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", line):
 63              items = []
 64              while index < len(lines) and re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", lines[index]):
 65                  item_text = re.sub(r"^\d+\.\s+", "", lines[index]).strip()
 66                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(item_text)}</li>")
 67                  index += 1
 68              parts.append("<ol>" + "".join(items) + "</ol>")
 69              continue
 70          paragraph = [line.strip()]
 71          index += 1
 72          while (
 73              index < len(lines)
 74              and lines[index].strip()
 75              and not lines[index].startswith(("#", "- ", "```"))
 76              and not re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", lines[index])
 77          ):
 78              paragraph.append(lines[index].strip())
 79              index += 1
 80          parts.append(f"<p>{inline(' '.join(paragraph))}</p>")
 81      return "\n".join(parts)
 82  
 83  
 84  def combined_markdown() -> str:
 85      files = sorted(CHAPTERS.glob("*.md"))
 86      if not files:
 87          raise SystemExit(f"코드북 마크다운이 없습니다: {CHAPTERS}")
 88      chunks = [path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() for path in files]
 89      return "\n\n".join(chunks) + "\n"

111              '<html lang="ko">',
