news_reading_note_proj/dist/assets/site.js

 1  /**
 2   * 사이트 공통 인터랙션 & 페이지 간 자연스러운 책장 넘김 트랜지션
 3   */
 4  
 5  (function () {
 6    'use strict';
 7  
 8    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
 9      // 1. note.php의 이전 날 / 다음 날 링크는 책 넘김 애니메이션 없이 즉시 이동 (기본 링크 이동)
10      const pagerPrev = document.querySelector('.note-pager a[data-direction="prev"]');
11      const pagerNext = document.querySelector('.note-pager a[data-direction="next"]');
12      const bookOuter = document.querySelector('.book-outer');
13  
14      // 키보드 좌/우 방향키로 이전/다음 날 이동 (note.php) - 즉시 이동
15      window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
16        if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
17        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && pagerNext) {
18          e.preventDefault();
19          window.location.href = pagerNext.href;
20        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && pagerPrev) {
21          e.preventDefault();
22          window.location.href = pagerPrev.href;
23        }
24      });
25  
26      // 모바일 터치 스와이프로 이전/다음 날 이동 (note.php) - 즉시 이동
27      if (bookOuter && (pagerPrev || pagerNext)) {
28        let touchStartX = 0;
29        let touchStartY = 0;
30        let touchStartTime = 0;
31        bookOuter.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
32          if (e.touches.length === 1) {
33            touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
34            touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
35            touchStartTime = Date.now();
36          }
37        }, { passive: true });
38  
39        bookOuter.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
40          if (e.changedTouches.length === 1) {
41            const diffX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
42            const diffY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - touchStartY;
43            const deltaTime = Date.now() - touchStartTime;
44  
45            // 수평 거리가 50px 이상이고, 수직 스크롤보다 수평 스와이프가 뚜렷할 때
46            if (Math.abs(diffX) > 50 && Math.abs(diffX) > Math.abs(diffY) * 1.3 && deltaTime < 500) {
47              if (diffX < 0 && pagerNext) {
48                window.location.href = pagerNext.href;
49              } else if (diffX > 0 && pagerPrev) {
50                window.location.href = pagerPrev.href;
51              }
52            }
53          }
54        }, { passive: true });
55      }
56  
57      // 가름끈 클릭 시 차례(archive.php) 또는 book.php로 이동
58      const ribbon = document.querySelector('.book-ribbon');
59      if (ribbon && !window.flipBookInstance) {
60        ribbon.addEventListener('click', () => {
61          window.location.href = '/archive.php';
62        });
63      }
64    });
65  
66  })();

news_reading_note_proj/docs/build_code_reference.py

  1  # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
  2  """신문 감상 기록 PHP·JS 소스에서 함수 설명 마크다운과 PDF를 만든다."""
  3  from __future__ import annotations
  4  
  5  import html
  6  import os
  7  import re
  8  import shutil
  9  import subprocess
 10  import tempfile
 11  from pathlib import Path
 12  
 13  ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
 14  DOCS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 15  MD_PATH = DOCS / "code-reference.md"
 16  HTML_PATH = DOCS / "code-reference.html"
 17  PDF_PATH = DOCS / "code-reference.pdf"
 18  
 19  ID_RE = re.compile(r"\d{7,8}")
 20  NAME_RE = re.compile("김신욱")
 21  PHP_FUNC = re.compile(
 22      r"^function\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)(?:\s*:\s*[\w\\?|]+)?",
 23  )
 24  JS_FUNC = re.compile(r"\s*function\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)")
 25  
 26  
 27  def mask_privacy(text: str) -> str:
 28      text = ID_RE.sub("OOOOOOOO", text)
 29      return NAME_RE.sub("OOO", text)
 30  
 31  
 32  def rel(path: Path) -> str:
 33      return path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
 34  
 35  
 36  class Doc:
 37      def __init__(self) -> None:
 38          self.blocks: list[tuple] = []
 39  
 40      def h1(self, text: str) -> None:
 41          self.blocks.append(("h1", text))
 42  
 43      def h2(self, text: str) -> None:
 44          self.blocks.append(("h2", text))
 45  
 46      def h3(self, text: str) -> None:
 47          self.blocks.append(("h3", text))
 48  
 49      def h4(self, text: str) -> None:
 50          self.blocks.append(("h4", text))
 51  
 52      def p(self, text: str) -> None:
 53          self.blocks.append(("p", text))
 54  
 55      def ul(self, items: list[str]) -> None:
 56          self.blocks.append(("ul", items))
 57  
 58      def code(self, text: str) -> None:
 59          self.blocks.append(("code", text))
 60  
 61      def render_md(self) -> str:
 62          out: list[str] = []
 63          for kind, payload in self.blocks:
 64              if kind == "h1":
 65                  out.append(f"# {payload}\n")
 66              elif kind == "h2":
 67                  out.append(f"\n## {payload}\n")
 68              elif kind == "h3":
 69                  out.append(f"\n### {payload}\n")
 70              elif kind == "h4":
 71                  out.append(f"\n#### {payload}\n")
 72              elif kind == "p":
 73                  out.append(payload + "\n")
 74              elif kind == "ul":
 75                  out.extend(f"- {item}" for item in payload)
 76                  out.append("")
 77              elif kind == "code":
 78                  out.append("```")
 79                  out.append(payload)
 80                  out.append("```\n")
 81          return mask_privacy("\n".join(out).strip() + "\n")
 82  
 83      def render_html(self) -> str:
 84          parts = [
 85              "<!DOCTYPE html>",
 86              '<html lang="ko">',
 87              "<head>",
 88              '<meta charset="utf-8" />',
 89              "<title>코드 레퍼런스</title>",
 90              "<style>",
 91              HTML_CSS,
 92              "</style>",
 93              "</head>",
 94              "<body>",
 95          ]
 96          first_h2 = True
 97          for kind, payload in self.blocks:
 98              if kind == "h1":
 99                  parts.append(f"<h1>{html.escape(payload)}</h1>")
100              elif kind == "h2":
101                  cls = "first" if first_h2 else ""
102                  first_h2 = False
103                  parts.append(f'<h2 class="{cls}">{html.escape(payload)}</h2>')
104              elif kind == "h3":
105                  parts.append(f"<h3>{html.escape(payload)}</h3>")
106              elif kind == "h4":
107                  parts.append(f"<h4>{html.escape(payload)}</h4>")
108              elif kind == "p":
109                  parts.append(f"<p>{inline_html(payload)}</p>")
110              elif kind == "ul":
111                  items = "".join(f"<li>{inline_html(item)}</li>" for item in payload)
112                  parts.append(f"<ul>{items}</ul>")
113              elif kind == "code":
114                  parts.append(f"<pre>{html.escape(payload)}</pre>")
115          parts.append("</body></html>")
116          return "\n".join(parts)
117  
118  
119  HTML_CSS = """
120  @page { margin: 18mm 16mm; }
121  body { font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.55; color: #1c1c1c; }
122  h1 { font-size: 22pt; margin: 0 0 0.6em; }
123  h2 { font-size: 16pt; margin: 1.4em 0 0.4em; page-break-before: always; }
124  h2.first { page-break-before: auto; }
125  h3 { font-size: 13pt; margin: 1.1em 0 0.3em; page-break-after: avoid; }
126  h4 { font-size: 11.5pt; margin: 0.9em 0 0.25em; page-break-after: avoid; }
127  p, li { orphans: 3; widows: 3; }
128  ul { margin: 0.2em 0 0.8em; padding-left: 1.2em; }
129  code { font-family: Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace; font-size: 9.5pt; }
130  pre { font-family: Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace; font-size: 9.5pt; background: #f3f3f3;
131        padding: 8px 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; page-break-inside: avoid; }
132  """
133  
134  INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`")
135  BOLD = re.compile(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*")
136  
137  
138  def inline_html(text: str) -> str:
139      escaped = html.escape(text)
140      escaped = INLINE_CODE.sub(lambda m: f"<code>{m.group(1)}</code>", escaped)
141      escaped = BOLD.sub(lambda m: f"<strong>{m.group(1)}</strong>", escaped)
142      return escaped
143  
144  
145  def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
146      return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
147  
148  
149  def block_comment_before(lines: list[str], index: int) -> str:
150      if index == 0:
151          return ""
152      line = lines[index - 1].strip()
153      if line != "*/":
154          return ""
155      start = index - 1
156      while start >= 0 and "/**" not in lines[start]:
157          start -= 1
158      if start < 0:
159          return ""
160      body: list[str] = []
161      for raw in lines[start:index]:
162          cleaned = re.sub(r"^\s*/?\*+/?\s?", "", raw).strip()
163          if cleaned and cleaned not in ("/**", "*/", "*"):
164              body.append(cleaned)
165      return " ".join(body).strip()
166  
167  
168  def parse_php(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
169      lines = read_text(path).splitlines()
170      symbols: list[dict] = []
171      for index, line in enumerate(lines):
172          match = PHP_FUNC.match(line.strip())
173          if not match:
174              continue
175          name = match.group(1)
176          params = match.group(2).strip()
177          doc = block_comment_before(lines, index)
178          symbols.append(
179              {
180                  "name": name,
181                  "signature": f"function {name}({params})",
182                  "line": index + 1,
183                  "desc": doc or "설명 주석이 없습니다. 코드북을 참고하세요.",
184              }
185          )
186      return symbols
187  
188  
189  def jsdoc_before(lines: list[str], index: int) -> str:
190      return block_comment_before(lines, index)
191  
192  
193  def parse_js(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
194      lines = read_text(path).splitlines()
195      symbols: list[dict] = []
196      for index, line in enumerate(lines):
197          match = JS_FUNC.match(line)
198          if not match:
199              continue
200          doc = jsdoc_before(lines, index)
201          symbols.append(
202              {
203                  "name": match.group(1),
204                  "signature": f"function {match.group(1)}({match.group(2).strip()})",
205                  "line": index + 1,
206                  "desc": doc or "설명 주석이 없습니다.",
207              }
208          )
209      return symbols
210  
211  
212  def site_php_files() -> list[Path]:
213      site = ROOT / "site"
214      files = sorted(site.rglob("*.php"), key=lambda p: p.as_posix())
215      return [p for p in files if "config.php" not in p.name]
216  
217  
218  def script_php_files() -> list[Path]:
219      scripts = ROOT / "scripts"
220      return sorted(scripts.rglob("*.php"), key=lambda p: p.as_posix())
221  
222  
223  def js_files() -> list[Path]:
224      assets = ROOT / "site" / "assets"
225      return sorted(assets.glob("*.js"), key=lambda p: p.name)
226  
227  
228  def add_symbols(doc: Doc, path: Path, symbols: list[dict]) -> None:
229      doc.h3(rel(path))
230      if not symbols:
231          doc.p("이 파일에 최상위 function 선언이 없습니다.")
232          return
233      for symbol in symbols:
234          doc.h4(symbol["name"])
235          doc.p(f"`{rel(path)}:{symbol['line']}`")
236          doc.code(symbol["signature"])
237          doc.p(symbol["desc"])
238  
239  
240  def build() -> Doc:
241      doc = Doc()
242      doc.h1("코드 레퍼런스")
243      doc.p(
244          "신문 감상 기록 사이트의 PHP includes·페이지·관리 화면, 빌드 스크립트, "
245          "그리고 `site/assets` JavaScript 함수 시그니처를 정리한 문서입니다. "
246          "상세 해설은 `documentation/codebook.pdf`를, 요구·시험은 `documentation/technical-specs.pdf`를 참고하세요."
247      )
248  
249      doc.h2("공통 includes")
250      for path in [
251          ROOT / "site" / "includes" / "bootstrap.php",
252          ROOT / "site" / "includes" / "fallback_data.php",
253          ROOT / "site" / "includes" / "layout.php",
254          ROOT / "site" / "includes" / "repository.php",
255      ]:
256          add_symbols(doc, path, parse_php(path))
257  
258      doc.h2("공개 페이지")
259      for path in sorted((ROOT / "site").glob("*.php"), key=lambda p: p.name):
260          if path.name == "config.example.php":
261              continue
262          add_symbols(doc, path, parse_php(path))
263  
264      doc.h2("관리 화면")
265      admin = ROOT / "site" / "admin"
266      for path in sorted(admin.glob("*.php"), key=lambda p: p.name):
267          add_symbols(doc, path, parse_php(path))
268  
269      doc.h2("빌드 스크립트")
270      for path in script_php_files():
271          add_symbols(doc, path, parse_php(path))
272  
273      doc.h2("클라이언트 자산")
274      for path in js_files():
275          add_symbols(doc, path, parse_js(path))
276  
277      return doc
278  
279  
280  def find_browser() -> Path | None:
281      local = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")
282      candidates = [
283          Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
284          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
285          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"),
286          Path(local) / "Google" / "Chrome" / "Application" / "chrome.exe",
287      ]
288      for candidate in candidates:
289          if candidate.is_file():
290              return candidate
291      return None
292  
293  
294  def write_pdf(html_path: Path, pdf_path: Path) -> None:
295      browser = find_browser()
296      if browser is None:
297          raise SystemExit("PDF로 인쇄할 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
298      if pdf_path.exists():
299          pdf_path.unlink()
300      profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="code-ref-pdf-"))
301      command = [
302          str(browser),
303          "--headless=new",
304          "--disable-gpu",
305          "--no-first-run",
306          "--no-pdf-header-footer",
307          f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
308          f"--print-to-pdf={pdf_path.resolve()}",
309          html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
310      ]
311      try:
312          subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=120)
313      finally:
314          shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
315      if not pdf_path.is_file() or pdf_path.stat().st_size < 1000:
316          raise SystemExit(f"PDF가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {pdf_path}")
317  
318  
319  def main() -> None:
320      doc = build()
321      MD_PATH.write_text(doc.render_md(), encoding="utf-8")
322      HTML_PATH.write_text(doc.render_html(), encoding="utf-8")
323      write_pdf(HTML_PATH, PDF_PATH)
324      print(f"Wrote {MD_PATH}")
325      print(f"Wrote {HTML_PATH}")
326      print(f"Wrote {PDF_PATH} ({PDF_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
327  
328  
329  if __name__ == "__main__":
330      main()

news_reading_note_proj/docs/build_codebook.py

  1  # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
  2  """코드북 마크다운을 이어 한글 PDF로 만든다."""
  3  from __future__ import annotations
  4  
  5  import html
  6  import os
  7  import re
  8  import shutil
  9  import subprocess
 10  import tempfile
 11  from pathlib import Path
 12  
 13  ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 14  CHAPTERS = ROOT / "codebook"
 15  MD_PATH = ROOT / "codebook.md"
 16  HTML_PATH = ROOT / "codebook.html"
 17  PDF_PATH = ROOT / "codebook.pdf"
 18  
 19  INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`")
 20  BOLD = re.compile(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*")
 21  
 22  
 23  def inline(text: str) -> str:
 24      escaped = html.escape(text)
 25      escaped = INLINE_CODE.sub(lambda match: f"<code>{match.group(1)}</code>", escaped)
 26      escaped = BOLD.sub(lambda match: f"<strong>{match.group(1)}</strong>", escaped)
 27      return escaped
 28  
 29  
 30  def markdown_to_html(text: str) -> str:
 31      lines = text.splitlines()
 32      parts: list[str] = []
 33      index = 0
 34      while index < len(lines):
 35          line = lines[index]
 36          if line.startswith("```"):
 37              body: list[str] = []
 38              index += 1
 39              while index < len(lines) and not lines[index].startswith("```"):
 40                  body.append(lines[index])
 41                  index += 1
 42              index += 1
 43              parts.append(f'<pre class="code">{html.escape(chr(10).join(body))}</pre>')
 44              continue
 45          if not line.strip():
 46              index += 1
 47              continue
 48          if line.startswith("#"):
 49              level = len(line) - len(line.lstrip("#"))
 50              level = min(max(level, 1), 4)
 51              title = line[level:].strip()
 52              parts.append(f"<h{level}>{inline(title)}</h{level}>")
 53              index += 1
 54              continue
 55          if line.startswith("- "):
 56              items: list[str] = []
 57              while index < len(lines) and lines[index].startswith("- "):
 58                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(lines[index][2:].strip())}</li>")
 59                  index += 1
 60              parts.append("<ul>" + "".join(items) + "</ul>")
 61              continue
 62          if re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", line):
 63              items = []
 64              while index < len(lines) and re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", lines[index]):
 65                  item_text = re.sub(r"^\d+\.\s+", "", lines[index]).strip()
 66                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(item_text)}</li>")
 67                  index += 1
 68              parts.append("<ol>" + "".join(items) + "</ol>")
 69              continue
 70          paragraph = [line.strip()]
 71          index += 1
 72          while (
 73              index < len(lines)
 74              and lines[index].strip()
 75              and not lines[index].startswith(("#", "- ", "```"))
 76              and not re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", lines[index])
 77          ):
 78              paragraph.append(lines[index].strip())
 79              index += 1
 80          parts.append(f"<p>{inline(' '.join(paragraph))}</p>")
 81      return "\n".join(parts)
 82  
 83  
 84  def combined_markdown() -> str:
 85      files = sorted(CHAPTERS.glob("*.md"))
 86      if not files:
 87          raise SystemExit(f"코드북 마크다운이 없습니다: {CHAPTERS}")
 88      chunks = [path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() for path in files]
 89      return "\n\n".join(chunks) + "\n"

107  def render_html(body: str) -> str:
108      return "\n".join(
109          [
110              "<!DOCTYPE html>",
111              '<html lang="ko">',
112              "<head>",
113              '<meta charset="utf-8" />',
114              "<title>코드북</title>",
115              "<style>",

117              "</style>",

121              "</body>",
122              "</html>",
123          ]
124      )

127  def find_browser() -> Path | None:
128      local = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")
129      candidates = [
130          Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
131          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
132          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"),
133          Path(local) / "Google" / "Chrome" / "Application" / "chrome.exe",
134      ]
135      for candidate in candidates:
136          if candidate.is_file():
137              return candidate
138      return None
139  
140  
141  def write_pdf(html_path: Path, pdf_path: Path) -> None:
142      browser = find_browser()
143      if browser is None:
144          raise SystemExit("PDF로 인쇄할 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
145      if pdf_path.exists():
146          pdf_path.unlink()
147      profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="codebook-pdf-"))
148      command = [
149          str(browser),
150          "--headless=new",
151          "--disable-gpu",
152          "--no-first-run",
153          "--no-pdf-header-footer",
154          f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
155          f"--print-to-pdf={pdf_path.resolve()}",
156          html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
157      ]
158      try:
159          subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=120)
160      finally:
161          shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
162      if not pdf_path.is_file() or pdf_path.stat().st_size < 1000:
163          raise SystemExit(f"PDF가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {pdf_path}")
164  
165  
166  def main() -> None:
167      markdown = combined_markdown()
168      MD_PATH.write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")
169      HTML_PATH.write_text(render_html(markdown_to_html(markdown)), encoding="utf-8")
170      write_pdf(HTML_PATH, PDF_PATH)
171      print(f"Wrote {MD_PATH}")
172      print(f"Wrote {HTML_PATH}")
173      print(f"Wrote {PDF_PATH} ({PDF_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
174  
175  
176  if __name__ == "__main__":
177      main()

  1  # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
  2  """포트폴리오 북 마크다운 챕터들을 통합하여 A4 규격의 한글 PDF 단행본으로 빌드한다.
  3  
  4  마크다운 표, 인용구, 코드 블록, 인라인 링크 및 Mermaid 다이어그램을 파싱하여
  5  Microsoft Edge 또는 Google Chrome 헤드리스 엔진으로 고품질 인쇄용 PDF를 생성한다.
  6  """
  7  from __future__ import annotations
  8  
  9  import hashlib
 10  import html
 11  import os
 12  import re
 13  import shutil
 14  import subprocess
 15  import tempfile
 16  import time
 17  from pathlib import Path
 18  
 19  from PIL import Image, ImageChops
 20  
 21  ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 22  CHAPTERS = ROOT / "portfolio-book"
 23  DIAGRAMS = CHAPTERS / "diagrams"
 24  MD_PATH = ROOT / "portfolio-book.md"
 25  HTML_PATH = ROOT / "portfolio-book.html"
 26  PDF_PATH = ROOT / "portfolio-book.pdf"
 27  USED_DIAGRAMS: set[str] = set()
 28  
 29  INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`")
 30  BOLD = re.compile(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*")
 31  LINK = re.compile(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)")
 32  
 33  
 34  def inline(text: str) -> str:
 35      escaped = html.escape(text)
 36      escaped = INLINE_CODE.sub(lambda m: f"<code>{m.group(1)}</code>", escaped)
 37      escaped = BOLD.sub(lambda m: f"<strong>{m.group(1)}</strong>", escaped)
 38      escaped = LINK.sub(lambda m: f'<a href="{m.group(2)}">{m.group(1)}</a>', escaped)
 39      return escaped
 40  
 41  
 42  def find_browser() -> Path | None:
 43      local = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")
 44      candidates = [
 45          Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
 46          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
 47          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"),
 48          Path(local) / "Google" / "Chrome" / "Application" / "chrome.exe",
 49      ]
 50      for candidate in candidates:
 51          if candidate.is_file():
 52              return candidate
 53      return None
 54  
 55  
 56  def diagram_page(source: str) -> str:
 57      escaped = html.escape(source)
 58      return f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
 59  <html lang="ko">
 60  <head>
 61  <meta charset="utf-8" />
 62  <style>
 63    html, body {{ margin: 0; background: #fff; }}
 64    body {{ padding: 24px; }}
 65    .mermaid {{ font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; }}
 66  </style>
 67  </head>
 68  <body>
 69  <pre class="mermaid">{escaped}</pre>
 70  <script type="module">
 71    import mermaid from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11/dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs";
 72    mermaid.initialize({{ startOnLoad: true, theme: "neutral", fontFamily: "Malgun Gothic, sans-serif" }});
 73  </script>
 74  </body>
 75  </html>
 76  """
 77  
 78  
 79  def crop_whitespace(path: Path) -> None:
 80      image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
 81      background = Image.new("RGB", image.size, (255, 255, 255))
 82      box = ImageChops.difference(image, background).getbbox()
 83      if box is None:
 84          raise SystemExit(f"차트가 비어 있습니다: {path.name}")
 85      pad = 16
 86      left = max(box[0] - pad, 0)
 87      top = max(box[1] - pad, 0)
 88      right = min(box[2] + pad, image.width)
 89      bottom = min(box[3] + pad, image.height)
 90      cropped = image.crop((left, top, right, bottom))
 91      if cropped.width < 40 or cropped.height < 40:
 92          raise SystemExit(f"차트가 너무 작습니다: {path.name}")
 93      cropped.save(path)
 94  
 95  
 96  def render_diagram(source: str) -> str:
 97      digest = hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
 98      USED_DIAGRAMS.add(digest)
 99      DIAGRAMS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
100      png = DIAGRAMS / f"{digest}.png"
101      if not png.is_file():
102          browser = find_browser()
103          if browser is None:
104              escaped = html.escape(source.strip())
105              return f'<pre class="code diagram-fallback">{escaped}</pre>'
106          html_path = DIAGRAMS / f"{digest}.html"
107          html_path.write_text(diagram_page(source), encoding="utf-8")
108          profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="book-chart-"))
109          command = [
110              str(browser),
111              "--headless=new",
112              "--disable-gpu",
113              "--no-first-run",
114              "--hide-scrollbars",
115              "--force-device-scale-factor=2",
116              "--virtual-time-budget=12000",
117              "--window-size=1400,2200",
118              f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
119              f"--screenshot={png.resolve()}",
120              html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
121          ]
122          try:
123              subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=60)
124              deadline = time.time() + 8
125              while not png.is_file() and time.time() < deadline:
126                  time.sleep(0.3)
127              crop_whitespace(png)
128          except Exception as e:
129              print(f"[경고] 차트 렌더링 실패 ({digest}): {e}")
130              escaped = html.escape(source.strip())
131              return f'<pre class="code diagram-fallback">{escaped}</pre>'
132          finally:
133              shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
134              if html_path.exists():
135                  html_path.unlink()
136      rel = png.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
137      return f'<figure class="chart"><img src="{rel}" alt="다이어그램" /></figure>'
138  
139  
140  def parse_table(lines: list[str]) -> str:
141      rows: list[list[str]] = []
142      for line in lines:
143          raw_cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
144          rows.append(raw_cells)
145      if not rows:
146          return ""
147      header = rows[0]
148      data_rows = rows[1:]
149      # Check if the next row is a separator line (e.g. :---: | :---)
150      if data_rows and all(re.match(r"^:?-+:?$", cell) for cell in data_rows[0]):
151          data_rows = data_rows[1:]
152  
153      html_parts = ['<div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr>']
154      for cell in header:
155          html_parts.append(f"<th>{inline(cell)}</th>")
156      html_parts.append("</tr></thead><tbody>")
157      for r in data_rows:
158          html_parts.append("<tr>")
159          for cell in r:
160              html_parts.append(f"<td>{inline(cell)}</td>")
161          html_parts.append("</tr>")
162      html_parts.append("</tbody></table></div>")
163      return "".join(html_parts)
164  
165  
166  def markdown_to_html(text: str) -> str:
167      lines = text.splitlines()
168      parts: list[str] = []
169      index = 0
170      first_h1 = True
171  
172      while index < len(lines):
173          line = lines[index]
174  
175          # Fenced code blocks
176          if line.startswith("```"):
177              language = line[3:].strip()
178              body: list[str] = []
179              index += 1
180              while index < len(lines) and not lines[index].startswith("```"):
181                  body.append(lines[index])
182                  index += 1
183              index += 1
184              source = "\n".join(body).strip() + "\n"
185              if language == "mermaid":
186                  parts.append(render_diagram(source))
187              else:
188                  parts.append(f'<pre class="code"><code>{html.escape(source)}</code></pre>')
189              continue
190  
191          stripped = line.strip()
192          if not stripped:
193              index += 1
194              continue
195  
196          # Horizontal Rule
197          if stripped in ("---", "***", "___"):
198              parts.append('<hr class="divider" />')
199              index += 1
200              continue
201  
202          # Headings
203          if line.startswith("#"):
204              level = len(line) - len(line.lstrip("#"))
205              level = min(max(level, 1), 4)
206              title = line[level:].strip()
207              cls = ""
208              if level == 1:
209                  if first_h1:
210                      cls = ' class="book-title"'
211                      first_h1 = False
212                  else:
213                      cls = ' class="chapter-title"'
214              parts.append(f"<h{level}{cls}>{inline(title)}</h{level}>")
215              index += 1
216              continue
217  
218          # Blockquote
219          if line.startswith(">"):
220              quote_lines: list[str] = []
221              while index < len(lines) and (lines[index].startswith(">") or (lines[index].strip() and not lines[index].startswith("#"))):
222                  curr = lines[index]
223                  if curr.startswith(">"):
224                      curr = curr[1:].strip()
225                  else:
226                      curr = curr.strip()
227                  quote_lines.append(curr)
228                  index += 1
229              quote_body = "<br />".join(inline(ql) for ql in quote_lines if ql)
230              parts.append(f"<blockquote><p>{quote_body}</p></blockquote>")
231              continue
232  
233          # Tables (lines starting and ending with |)
234          if stripped.startswith("|") and stripped.endswith("|"):
235              table_lines: list[str] = []
236              while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip().startswith("|") and lines[index].strip().endswith("|"):
237                  table_lines.append(lines[index])
238                  index += 1
239              parts.append(parse_table(table_lines))
240              continue
241  
242          # Unordered Lists
243          if line.startswith("- ") or line.startswith("* "):
244              items: list[str] = []
245              while index < len(lines) and (lines[index].startswith("- ") or lines[index].startswith("* ")):
246                  item_content = lines[index][2:].strip()
247                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(item_content)}</li>")
248                  index += 1
249              parts.append(f"<ul>{''.join(items)}</ul>")
250              continue
251  
252          # Ordered Lists
253          ordered = re.match(r"^\d+\.\s+", line)
254          if ordered:
255              items = []
256              while index < len(lines) and re.match(r"^\d+\.\s+", lines[index]):
257                  item_text = re.sub(r"^\d+\.\s+", "", lines[index]).strip()
258                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(item_text)}</li>")
259                  index += 1
260              parts.append(f"<ol>{''.join(items)}</ol>")
261              continue
262  
263          # Paragraphs
264          paragraph = [line.strip()]
265          index += 1
266          while (
267              index < len(lines)
268              and lines[index].strip()
269              and not lines[index].startswith(("#", "- ", "* ", ">", "```"))
270              and not (lines[index].strip().startswith("|") and lines[index].strip().endswith("|"))
271              and not lines[index].strip() in ("---", "***", "___")
272              and not re.match(r"^\d+\.\s+", lines[index])
273          ):
274              paragraph.append(lines[index].strip())
275              index += 1
276          parts.append(f"<p>{inline(' '.join(paragraph))}</p>")
277  
278      return "\n".join(parts)
279  
280  
281  def combined_markdown() -> str:
282      files = sorted(CHAPTERS.glob("*.md"))
283      if not files:
284          raise SystemExit(f"포트폴리오 북 챕터 마크다운이 없습니다: {CHAPTERS}")
285      chunks = [path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() for path in files]
286      return "\n\n".join(chunks) + "\n"

547  
548      print("[2/4] 마크다운 -> HTML 변환 및 다이어그램 렌더링 중...")
549      html_content = render_html(markdown_to_html(markdown))
550      HTML_PATH.write_text(html_content, encoding="utf-8")
551      print(f"  -> HTML 저장: {HTML_PATH}")
552  
553      print("[3/4] 헤드리스 브라우저 A4 PDF 변환 중...")
554      write_pdf(HTML_PATH, PDF_PATH)
555      print(f"  -> PDF 완성: {PDF_PATH} ({PDF_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
556  
557      print("[4/4] 빌드 완료! 성공적으로 포트폴리오 북이 생성되었습니다.")
558  
559  
560  if __name__ == "__main__":
561      main()

news_reading_note_proj/docs/build_source_bundle.py

  1  # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
  2  """신문 감상 기록 사이트 소스를 파일 단위로 이어 PDF로 만든다."""
  3  from __future__ import annotations
  4  
  5  import html
  6  import os
  7  import shutil
  8  import subprocess
  9  import tempfile
 10  from pathlib import Path
 11  
 12  ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
 13  DOCS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 14  HTML_PATH = DOCS / "source-bundle.html"
 15  PDF_PATH = DOCS / "source-bundle.pdf"
 16  
 17  SUFFIXES = {".php", ".css", ".js", ".py", ".sql"}
 18  SKIP_DIRS = {
 19      "dist",
 20      "docs",
 21      "documentation",
 22      "__pycache__",
 23      ".local",
 24      ".git",
 25      "node_modules",
 26  }
 27  SKIP_FILES = {
 28      "config.php",
 29      "seed.sql",
 30  }
 31  SKIP_NAME_PARTS = ("감상노트 백업",)
 32  
 33  
 34  def include(path: Path) -> bool:
 35      if path.suffix.lower() not in SUFFIXES:
 36          return False
 37      if path.name in SKIP_FILES or path.name.endswith(".min.js"):
 38          return False
 39      if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in path.parts):
 40          return False
 41      if any(part in path.name for part in SKIP_NAME_PARTS):
 42          return False
 43      rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
 44      allowed_prefixes = ("site/", "scripts/", "database/schema.sql")
 45      if not any(rel == prefix.rstrip("/") or rel.startswith(prefix) for prefix in allowed_prefixes):
 46          return False
 47      return True
 48  
 49  
 50  def source_files() -> list[Path]:
 51      files = [path for path in ROOT.rglob("*") if path.is_file() and include(path)]
 52      return sorted(files, key=lambda path: path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
 53  
 54  
 55  def file_block(path: Path) -> str:
 56      rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
 57      text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 58      lines = text.splitlines()
 59      width = max(len(str(len(lines))), 2)
 60      numbered = "\n".join(f"{index:>{width}}  {line}" for index, line in enumerate(lines, start=1))
 61      return f"<h2>{html.escape(rel)}</h2>\n<pre>{html.escape(numbered)}</pre>"
 62  
 63  
 64  def render_html(blocks: list[str]) -> str:
 65      intro = (
 66          "<h1>소스 모음</h1>"
 67          "<p>신문 감상 기록 PHP 사이트의 <code>site/</code>, <code>scripts/</code>, "
 68          "<code>database/schema.sql</code>을 파일 순서대로 이어 두었습니다. "
 69          "감상 원문 txt, <code>config.php</code>, <code>seed.sql</code>, <code>dist/</code>는 넣지 않았습니다.</p>"
 70      )
 71      css = """
 72  @page { margin: 12mm 10mm; }
 73  body { font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; color: #1c1c1c; }
 74  h1 { font-size: 18pt; margin: 0 0 0.4em; }
 75  h2 { font-size: 12pt; margin: 1.2em 0 0.3em; page-break-before: always; page-break-after: avoid; }
 76  h2:first-of-type { page-break-before: auto; }
 77  p { font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 1.5; }
 78  pre { font-family: Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace; font-size: 8pt; line-height: 1.35;
 79        white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all; margin: 0; }
 80  """
 81      return "\n".join(
 82          [
 83              "<!DOCTYPE html>",
 84              '<html lang="ko">',
 85              "<head>",
 86              '<meta charset="utf-8" />',
 87              "<title>소스 모음</title>",
 88              "<style>",
 89              css,
 90              "</style>",
 91              "</head>",
 92              "<body>",
 93              intro,
 94              "\n".join(blocks),
 95              "</body>",
 96              "</html>",
 97          ]
 98      )
 99  
100  
101  def find_browser() -> Path | None:
102      local = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")
103      candidates = [
104          Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
105          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
106          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"),
107          Path(local) / "Google" / "Chrome" / "Application" / "chrome.exe",
108      ]
109      for candidate in candidates:
110          if candidate.is_file():
111              return candidate
112      return None
113  
114  
115  def write_pdf(html_path: Path, pdf_path: Path) -> None:
116      browser = find_browser()
117      if browser is None:
118          raise SystemExit("PDF로 인쇄할 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
119      if pdf_path.exists():
120          pdf_path.unlink()
121      profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="source-bundle-"))
122      command = [
123          str(browser),
124          "--headless=new",
125          "--disable-gpu",
126          "--no-first-run",
127          "--no-pdf-header-footer",
128          f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
129          f"--print-to-pdf={pdf_path.resolve()}",
130          html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
131      ]
132      try:
133          subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=180)
134      finally:
135          shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
136      if not pdf_path.is_file() or pdf_path.stat().st_size < 1000:
137          raise SystemExit(f"PDF가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {pdf_path}")
138  
139  
140  def main() -> None:
141      files = source_files()
142      if not files:
143          raise SystemExit("묶을 소스 파일이 없습니다.")
144      HTML_PATH.write_text(render_html([file_block(path) for path in files]), encoding="utf-8")
145      write_pdf(HTML_PATH, PDF_PATH)
146      print(f"Files {len(files)}")
147      print(f"Wrote {PDF_PATH} ({PDF_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
148  
149  
150  if __name__ == "__main__":
151      main()

news_reading_note_proj/docs/build_specs.py

  1  # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
  2  """기술명세 마크다운을 이어 한글 PDF로 만든다.
  3  
  4  Mermaid 차트는 Edge로 그린 뒤 잘라서 PNG로 넣는다.
  5  """
  6  from __future__ import annotations
  7  
  8  import hashlib
  9  import html
 10  import os
 11  import re
 12  import shutil
 13  import subprocess
 14  import tempfile
 15  import time
 16  from pathlib import Path
 17  
 18  from PIL import Image, ImageChops
 19  
 20  ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 21  SPECS = ROOT / "specs"
 22  DIAGRAMS = SPECS / "diagrams"
 23  MD_PATH = ROOT / "technical-specs.md"
 24  HTML_PATH = ROOT / "technical-specs.html"
 25  PDF_PATH = ROOT / "technical-specs.pdf"
 26  USED_DIAGRAMS: set[str] = set()
 27  
 28  INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`")
 29  BOLD = re.compile(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*")
 30  
 31  
 32  def inline(text: str) -> str:
 33      escaped = html.escape(text)
 34      escaped = INLINE_CODE.sub(lambda match: f"<code>{match.group(1)}</code>", escaped)
 35      escaped = BOLD.sub(lambda match: f"<strong>{match.group(1)}</strong>", escaped)
 36      return escaped
 37  
 38  
 39  def markdown_to_html(text: str) -> str:
 40      lines = text.splitlines()
 41      parts: list[str] = []
 42      index = 0
 43      while index < len(lines):
 44          line = lines[index]
 45          if line.startswith("```"):
 46              language = line[3:].strip()
 47              body: list[str] = []
 48              index += 1
 49              while index < len(lines) and not lines[index].startswith("```"):
 50                  body.append(lines[index])
 51                  index += 1
 52              index += 1
 53              source = "\n".join(body).strip() + "\n"
 54              if language == "mermaid":
 55                  parts.append(render_diagram(source))
 56              else:
 57                  parts.append(f'<pre class="code">{html.escape(source)}</pre>')
 58              continue
 59          if not line.strip():
 60              index += 1
 61              continue
 62          if line.startswith("#"):
 63              level = len(line) - len(line.lstrip("#"))
 64              level = min(max(level, 1), 4)
 65              title = line[level:].strip()
 66              parts.append(f"<h{level}>{inline(title)}</h{level}>")
 67              index += 1
 68              continue
 69          if line.startswith("- "):
 70              items: list[str] = []
 71              while index < len(lines) and lines[index].startswith("- "):
 72                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(lines[index][2:].strip())}</li>")
 73                  index += 1
 74              parts.append("<ul>" + "".join(items) + "</ul>")
 75              continue
 76          ordered = re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", line)
 77          if ordered:
 78              items = []
 79              while index < len(lines) and re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", lines[index]):
 80                  item_text = re.sub(r"^\d+\.\s+", "", lines[index]).strip()
 81                  items.append(f"<li>{inline(item_text)}</li>")
 82                  index += 1
 83              parts.append("<ol>" + "".join(items) + "</ol>")
 84              continue
 85          paragraph = [line.strip()]
 86          index += 1
 87          while (
 88              index < len(lines)
 89              and lines[index].strip()
 90              and not lines[index].startswith(("#", "- ", "```"))
 91              and not re.match(r"\d+\.\s+", lines[index])
 92          ):
 93              paragraph.append(lines[index].strip())
 94              index += 1
 95          parts.append(f"<p>{inline(' '.join(paragraph))}</p>")
 96      return "\n".join(parts)
 97  
 98  
 99  def combined_markdown() -> str:
100      files = sorted(SPECS.glob("*.md"))
101      if not files:
102          raise SystemExit(f"명세 마크다운이 없습니다: {SPECS}")
103      chunks = [path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() for path in files]
104      return "\n\n".join(chunks) + "\n"
105  
106  
107  HTML_CSS = """
108  @page { margin: 18mm 16mm; }
109  body { font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.55; color: #1c1c1c; }
110  h1 { font-size: 20pt; margin: 0 0 0.6em; page-break-before: always; }
111  h1:first-of-type { page-break-before: auto; }
112  h2 { font-size: 15pt; margin: 1.2em 0 0.4em; page-break-after: avoid; }
113  h3 { font-size: 12.5pt; margin: 1em 0 0.3em; page-break-after: avoid; }
114  p, li { orphans: 3; widows: 3; }
115  ul { margin: 0.2em 0 0.8em; padding-left: 1.2em; }
116  code { font-family: Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace; font-size: 9.5pt; }
117  pre { font-family: Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace; font-size: 9pt; background: #f3f3f3;
118        padding: 8px 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
119  figure.chart { margin: 0.4em 0 1em; text-align: center; page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid; }
120  figure.chart img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 230mm; width: auto; height: auto; }
121  """
122  
123  
124  def render_html(body: str) -> str:
125      return "\n".join(
126          [
127              "<!DOCTYPE html>",
128              '<html lang="ko">',
129              "<head>",
130              '<meta charset="utf-8" />',
131              "<title>기술명세</title>",
132              "<style>",
133              HTML_CSS,
134              "</style>",
135              "</head>",
136              "<body>",
137              body,
138              "</body>",
139              "</html>",
140          ]
141      )
142  
143  
144  def find_browser() -> Path | None:
145      local = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")
146      candidates = [
147          Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
148          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),
149          Path(r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"),
150          Path(local) / "Google" / "Chrome" / "Application" / "chrome.exe",
151      ]
152      for candidate in candidates:
153          if candidate.is_file():
154              return candidate
155      return None
156  
157  
158  ACTOR_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\[(.+)\]$")
159  CASE_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\(\[(.+)\]\)$")
160  BOUNDARY_LINE = re.compile(r"^subgraph\s+\w+\[(.+)\]$")
161  ASSOC_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\s+---\s+(\w+)$")
162  EXTEND_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\w+)\s+-\.->\|([^|]+)\|\s+(\w+)$")
163  BREAK_LINE = re.compile(r"<br\s*/?>")
164  
165  
166  def parse_usecase(source: str) -> tuple[str, list, list, list, list]:
167      actors: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
168      cases: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
169      assocs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
170      extends: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
171      boundary = "시스템"
172      for raw in source.splitlines():
173          line = raw.strip()
174          if not line or line.startswith(("%%", "flowchart", "direction")) or line == "end":
175              continue
176          found = BOUNDARY_LINE.match(line)
177          if found:
178              boundary = found.group(1)
179              continue
180          found = CASE_LINE.match(line)
181          if found:
182              cases.append((found.group(1), found.group(2)))
183              continue
184          found = ACTOR_LINE.match(line)
185          if found:
186              actors.append((found.group(1), found.group(2)))
187              continue
188          found = ASSOC_LINE.match(line)
189          if found:
190              assocs.append((found.group(1), found.group(2)))
191              continue
192          found = EXTEND_LINE.match(line)
193          if found:
194              extends.append((found.group(1), found.group(2), found.group(3)))
195      if not actors or not cases:
196          raise SystemExit("사람 그림으로 그릴 행위자나 유스케이스가 없습니다.")
197      return boundary, actors, cases, assocs, extends
198  
199  
200  def text_width(text: str) -> int:
201      return sum(17 if ord(char) > 127 else 9 for char in text)
202  
203  
204  def usecase_svg(source: str) -> str:
205      boundary, actors, cases, assocs, extends = parse_usecase(source)
206      parsed = [(case_id, BREAK_LINE.split(label)) for case_id, label in cases]
207      ellipse_w = max(max(text_width(line) for line in lines) for _, lines in parsed) + 52
208      row_h = 78
209      ellipse_h = 50
210      pad_top = 40
211      pad_x = 48
212      boundary_x = 188
213      boundary_y = 10
214      extend_room = 28
215      boundary_w = pad_x + ellipse_w + pad_x + extend_room
216      boundary_h = pad_top + row_h * len(parsed) + 8
217      ellipse_x = boundary_x + pad_x
218      centers: dict[str, float] = {}
219      for index, (case_id, _) in enumerate(parsed):
220          centers[case_id] = boundary_y + pad_top + index * row_h + ellipse_h / 2
221      linked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
222      for actor_id, case_id in assocs:
223          linked.setdefault(actor_id, []).append(case_id)
224  
225      def actor_anchor(actor_id: str) -> float:
226          targets = linked.get(actor_id, [])
227          if not targets:
228              return boundary_y + boundary_h / 2
229          return sum(centers[case_id] for case_id in targets) / len(targets)
230  
231      width = boundary_x + boundary_w + 20
232      height = boundary_y + boundary_h + 28
233      parts = [
234          f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">',
235          "<defs><marker id='extend-arrow' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='7' refY='4' orient='auto'>",
236          "<path d='M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z' fill='#555'/></marker></defs>",
237          f"<rect x='{boundary_x}' y='{boundary_y}' width='{boundary_w}' height='{boundary_h}' fill='none' stroke='#9a9a9a' stroke-width='1.4'/>",
238          f"<text x='{boundary_x + boundary_w / 2}' y='{boundary_y + 24}' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#333'>{html.escape(boundary)}</text>",
239      ]
240      hands: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
241      for index, (actor_id, name) in enumerate(actors):
242          center_x = 78
243          center_y = actor_anchor(actor_id)
244          radius = 13
245          head_y = center_y - 34
246          neck = head_y + radius
247          hip = neck + 30
248          arm_y = neck + 12
249          foot = hip + 24
250          arm = 20
251          leg = 15
252          parts.append(
253              f"<g fill='none' stroke='#222' stroke-width='1.7' stroke-linecap='round'>"
254              f"<circle cx='{center_x}' cy='{head_y}' r='{radius}'/>"
255              f"<line x1='{center_x}' y1='{neck}' x2='{center_x}' y2='{hip}'/>"
256              f"<line x1='{center_x - arm}' y1='{arm_y}' x2='{center_x + arm}' y2='{arm_y}'/>"
257              f"<line x1='{center_x}' y1='{hip}' x2='{center_x - leg}' y2='{foot}'/>"
258              f"<line x1='{center_x}' y1='{hip}' x2='{center_x + leg}' y2='{foot}'/>"
259              f"</g>"
260              f"<text x='{center_x}' y='{foot + 20}' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#222'>{html.escape(name)}</text>"
261          )
262          hands[actor_id] = (center_x + arm, arm_y)
263      for actor_id, case_id in assocs:
264          start_x, start_y = hands[actor_id]
265          end_x = ellipse_x
266          end_y = centers[case_id]
267          bend = (start_x + end_x) / 2
268          parts.append(
269              f"<path d='M {start_x} {start_y} C {bend} {start_y}, {bend} {end_y}, {end_x} {end_y}' fill='none' stroke='#777' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
270          )
271      right = ellipse_x + ellipse_w
272      for source_id, label, target_id in extends:
273          start_y = centers[source_id]
274          end_y = centers[target_id]
275          lane = right + 16
276          mid_y = (start_y + end_y) / 2
277          parts.append(
278              f"<path d='M {right} {start_y} C {lane} {start_y}, {lane} {end_y}, {right} {end_y}' fill='none' stroke='#555' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-dasharray='4 3' marker-end='url(#extend-arrow)'/>"
279              f"<text x='{lane + 8}' y='{mid_y + 4}' font-size='13' fill='#333'>{html.escape(label)}</text>"
280          )
281      for case_id, lines in parsed:
282          center_y = centers[case_id]
283          parts.append(
284              f"<ellipse cx='{ellipse_x + ellipse_w / 2}' cy='{center_y}' rx='{ellipse_w / 2}' ry='{ellipse_h / 2}' fill='#f4f4f4' stroke='#666' stroke-width='1.3'/>"
285          )
286          if len(lines) == 1:
287              parts.append(
288                  f"<text x='{ellipse_x + ellipse_w / 2}' y='{center_y + 5}' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#222'>{html.escape(lines[0])}</text>"
289              )
290          else:
291              first = center_y - 6
292              spans = "".join(
293                  f"<tspan x='{ellipse_x + ellipse_w / 2}' y='{first + offset * 18}'>{html.escape(line)}</tspan>"
294                  for offset, line in enumerate(lines)
295              )
296              parts.append(f"<text text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='#222'>{spans}</text>")
297      parts.append("</svg>")
298      return "".join(parts)
299  
300  
301  def svg_page(svg: str) -> str:
302      return f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
303  <html lang="ko">
304  <head>
305  <meta charset="utf-8" />
306  <style>
307    html, body {{ margin: 0; background: #fff; }}
308    body {{ padding: 20px; font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; }}
309    svg {{ font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; }}
310  </style>
311  </head>
312  <body>
313  {svg}
314  </body>
315  </html>
316  """
317  
318  
319  def diagram_page(source: str) -> str:
320      if "actor-style: person" in source:
321          return svg_page(usecase_svg(source))
322      escaped = html.escape(source)
323      return f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
324  <html lang="ko">
325  <head>
326  <meta charset="utf-8" />
327  <style>
328    html, body {{ margin: 0; background: #fff; }}
329    body {{ padding: 24px; }}
330    .mermaid {{ font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; }}
331  </style>
332  </head>
333  <body>
334  <pre class="mermaid">{escaped}</pre>
335  <script type="module">
336    import mermaid from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11/dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs";
337    mermaid.initialize({{ startOnLoad: true, theme: "neutral", fontFamily: "Malgun Gothic, sans-serif" }});
338  </script>
339  </body>
340  </html>
341  """
342  
343  
344  def crop_whitespace(path: Path) -> None:
345      image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
346      background = Image.new("RGB", image.size, (255, 255, 255))
347      box = ImageChops.difference(image, background).getbbox()
348      if box is None:
349          raise SystemExit(f"차트가 비어 있습니다: {path.name}")
350      pad = 16
351      left = max(box[0] - pad, 0)
352      top = max(box[1] - pad, 0)
353      right = min(box[2] + pad, image.width)
354      bottom = min(box[3] + pad, image.height)
355      cropped = image.crop((left, top, right, bottom))
356      if cropped.width < 40 or cropped.height < 40:
357          raise SystemExit(f"차트가 너무 작습니다: {path.name}")
358      cropped.save(path)
359  
360  
361  def render_diagram(source: str) -> str:
362      digest = hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
363      USED_DIAGRAMS.add(digest)
364      DIAGRAMS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
365      png = DIAGRAMS / f"{digest}.png"
366      if not png.is_file():
367          browser = find_browser()
368          if browser is None:
369              raise SystemExit("차트를 그릴 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
370          html_path = DIAGRAMS / f"{digest}.html"
371          html_path.write_text(diagram_page(source), encoding="utf-8")
372          profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="specs-chart-"))
373          command = [
374              str(browser),
375              "--headless=new",
376              "--disable-gpu",
377              "--no-first-run",
378              "--hide-scrollbars",
379              "--force-device-scale-factor=2",
380              "--virtual-time-budget=12000",
381              "--window-size=1400,2200",
382              f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
383              f"--screenshot={png.resolve()}",
384              html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
385          ]
386          try:
387              subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=60)
388              deadline = time.time() + 8
389              while not png.is_file() and time.time() < deadline:
390                  time.sleep(0.2)
391          finally:
392              html_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
393              shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
394          if not png.is_file():
395              raise SystemExit(f"차트 이미지가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {png.name}")
396          crop_whitespace(png)
397      relative = png.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
398      return f'<figure class="chart"><img src="{html.escape(relative)}" alt="차트" /></figure>'
399  
400  
401  def cleanup_diagrams() -> None:
402      if not DIAGRAMS.is_dir():
403          return
404      for path in DIAGRAMS.iterdir():
405          if path.is_dir():
406              shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
407          elif path.stem not in USED_DIAGRAMS:
408              path.unlink()
409  
410  
411  def write_pdf(html_path: Path, pdf_path: Path) -> None:
412      browser = find_browser()
413      if browser is None:
414          raise SystemExit("PDF로 인쇄할 Edge 또는 Chrome을 찾지 못했습니다.")
415      if pdf_path.exists():
416          pdf_path.unlink()
417      profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="specs-pdf-"))
418      command = [
419          str(browser),
420          "--headless=new",
421          "--disable-gpu",
422          "--no-first-run",
423          "--no-pdf-header-footer",
424          f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
425          f"--print-to-pdf={pdf_path.resolve()}",
426          html_path.resolve().as_uri(),
427      ]
428      try:
429          subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=120)
430      finally:
431          shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
432      if not pdf_path.is_file() or pdf_path.stat().st_size < 1000:
433          raise SystemExit(f"PDF가 만들어지지 않았습니다: {pdf_path}")
434  
435  
436  def main() -> None:
437      markdown = combined_markdown()
438      MD_PATH.write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")
439      HTML_PATH.write_text(render_html(markdown_to_html(markdown)), encoding="utf-8")
440      cleanup_diagrams()
441      write_pdf(HTML_PATH, PDF_PATH)
442      print(f"Wrote {MD_PATH}")
443      print(f"Wrote {HTML_PATH}")
444      print(f"Wrote {PDF_PATH} ({PDF_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
445  
446  
447  if __name__ == "__main__":
448      main()

  23  <body>
  24  <h1>코드 설명</h1>
  25  <p>이력서, 자기소개, 온라인 명함, 학습 기록 대시보드와 그 빌드 스크립트를 함수·클래스 단위로 정리한 문서다. 설명은 소스 주석에서 뽑았고, 함수가 없는 파일은 파일 역할만 적었다.</p>
  26  <h2 class="first">프로젝트 구성</h2>
  27  <p>루트는 취업 지원용 포트폴리오 페이지다. 이력서, 자기소개, 명함은 각각 폴더로 나뉘고, 학습 노트와 과제 원본은 study_note_record_organization 안에 있다. 그 폴더의 파이썬 스크립트가 원본을 요약 마크다운으로 바꾸고, 대시보드가 읽는 data.js와 원본 JSON을 만든다.</p>
  28  <ul><li>index.html, css/, js/main.js — 메인 포트폴리오</li><li>cv/ — 이력서</li><li>cover_letter/ — 자기소개</li><li>online_business_card/ — 스크롤 명함</li><li>study_note_record_organization/dashboard/ — 학습·과제 카드 화면</li><li>study_note_record_organization/scripts/ — 요약과 정적 데이터 빌드</li><li>study_note_record_organization/data/ — 노트, 과제, 이미지 원본</li></ul>
  29  <h2 class="">디렉터리 지도</h2>
  30  <ul><li>css/ — 메인 페이지와 공통 헤더 스타일</li><li>js/ — 메인 페이지 내비게이션, 테마 및 리소스 보호(protect-resources.js)</li><li>cv/css, cv/js — 이력서 스타일과 재직 기간 계산</li><li>cover_letter/css, cover_letter/js — 자기소개 스타일과 스크롤 메뉴</li><li>online_business_card/css, online_business_card/js — 명함 애니메이션</li><li>study_note_record_organization/dashboard/js — 카드, 검색, 히어로. data.js와 sources는 생성물</li><li>study_note_record_organization/scripts — build_output.py, build_static_site.py, extract_sources.py</li><li>study_note_record_organization/output — 빌드가 쓰는 요약 마크다운과 catalog.json</li><li>study_note_record_organization/data/과제분류하기 — 과제 문서 원본. 코드 파일은 이 문서에서 빼 둔다</li><li>docs/ — 기술명세서, 코드북, 코드 설명, 소스 번들, 포트폴리오 북 빌드 스크립트</li></ul>
  31  <h2 class="">메인 사이트 및 보안 가드</h2>
  32  <h3>index.html</h3>
  33  <p>포트폴리오 메인 화면. 지원 동기, 성장·학습, 역량 절과 자료 메뉴를 담고, 저장된 라이트·다크 테마를 그리기 전에 적용한다.</p>
  34  <h3>css/styles.css</h3>
  35  <p>메인 페이지의 색, 글자 크기, 섹션, 라이트·다크 테마를 정한다.</p>
  36  <h3>css/site-header.css</h3>
  37  <p>여러 페이지가 공유하는 상단 헤더, 내비게이션, 자료 드롭다운, 모바일 메뉴의 배치와 색을 정한다.</p>
  38  <h3>js/main.js</h3>
  39  <p>포트폴리오 메인 페이지의 내비게이션, 자료 드롭다운, 테마 전환을 초기화한다.
  40  DOM이 준비되면 부드러운 앵커 이동, 모바일 메뉴, 섹션 포커스를 연결한다.</p>
  41  <h4>prefersReducedMotion</h4>
  42  <p><code>js/main.js:17</code></p>
  43  <pre>function prefersReducedMotion()</pre>
  44  <p>사용자가 동작 줄이기를 켰는지 확인한다. 켜져 있으면 스크롤을 즉시 이동하고, 아니면 부드럽게 이동한다.</p>
  45  <ul><li>인자: 없음</li><li>반환: boolean</li></ul>
  46  <p>유사코드</p>
  47  <pre>반환 mqReduceMotion ? mqReduceMotion.matches : false</pre>
  48  <h4>queryAll</h4>

  50  <pre>function queryAll(selector)</pre>
  51  <p>문서 전체에서 선택자와 맞는 요소를 배열로 돌려준다.</p>
  52  <ul><li>인자: selector: string CSS 선택자</li><li>반환: Element[]</li></ul>
  53  <p>유사코드</p>

  61  <pre>반환 Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(selector))</pre>

 148  <h4>applyTheme</h4>

 167  <pre>시도
 168    반환 localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY)

 171  <h4>setStoredTheme</h4>
 172  <p><code>js/main.js:197</code></p>
 173  <pre>function setStoredTheme(theme)</pre>
 174  <p>선택한 테마를 브라우저 저장소에 남긴다. 저장이 막히면 현재 페이지만 유지한다.</p>
 175  <ul><li>인자: theme: string 저장할 테마 이름</li><li>반환: 없음</li></ul>
 176  <p>유사코드</p>
 177  <pre>시도
 178    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, theme)
 179    } catch (e)</pre>
 180  <h4>setResourceDropdown</h4>
 181  <p><code>js/main.js:210</code></p>
 182  <pre>function setResourceDropdown(dropdown, open)</pre>
 183  <p>자료 드롭다운 하나의 열림 상태, 버튼 표시, 메뉴 숨김을 맞춘다.</p>
 184  <ul><li>인자: dropdown: Element 드롭다운 루트, open: boolean 열지 여부</li><li>반환: 없음</li></ul>
 185  <p>유사코드</p>
 186  <pre>toggle ← dropdown.querySelector(&quot;.site-nav__dropdown-toggle&quot;)
 187  menu ← dropdown.querySelector(&quot;.site-nav__dropdown-menu&quot;)

 189  만약 toggle) toggle.setAttribute(&quot;aria-expanded&quot;, open ? &quot;true&quot; : &quot;false&quot;
 190  만약 menu) menu.hidden = !open</pre>
 191  <h4>closeResourceDropdowns</h4>
 192  <p><code>js/main.js:222</code></p>
 193  <pre>function closeResourceDropdowns(except)</pre>
 194  <p>지정한 하나를 제외한 자료 드롭다운을 모두 닫는다.</p>
 195  <ul><li>인자: except: Element= 닫지 않을 드롭다운</li><li>반환: 없음</li></ul>
 196  <p>유사코드</p>
 197  <pre>queryAll(&quot;.site-nav__dropdown&quot;).forEach(function (dropdown)
 198    만약 except &amp;&amp; dropdown === except) return
 199    setResourceDropdown(dropdown, false)</pre>
 200  <h4>closeMobileNav</h4>
 201  <p><code>js/main.js:234</code></p>
 202  <pre>function closeMobileNav(nav, toggle)</pre>
 203  <p>모바일 내비게이션을 닫고, 함께 열려 있던 자료 드롭다운도 닫는다.</p>
 204  <ul><li>인자: nav: HTMLElement | null 내비게이션 요소, toggle: HTMLElement | null 햄버거 버튼</li><li>반환: 없음</li></ul>
 205  <p>유사코드</p>
 206  <pre>setMobileNav(nav, toggle, false)</pre>
 207  <h4>setMobileNav</h4>
 208  <p><code>js/main.js:245</code></p>
 209  <pre>function setMobileNav(nav, toggle, open)</pre>
 210  <p>모바일 내비게이션의 열림 클래스와 버튼 안내 문구를 설정한다. 닫을 때는 자료 드롭다운도 함께 닫는다.</p>

 438    아니면

 440    rotateX = 0
 441    rotateY = 180

 443    scale = 1 + (40 * easeScale); // 화면을 덮도록 크게 확대
 444    card.style.opacity = 1
 445  card.style.transform = `rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) s…
 446  만약 scrollHint
 447    scrollHint.classList.toggle(&#x27;is-hidden&#x27;, scrollY &gt; 24)
 448  ticking = false</pre>

 935  <h2 class="">빌드 스크립트</h2>
 936  <p>scripts 폴더와 docs 폴더의 파이썬 스크립트가 학습 원본 요약, 대시보드 데이터 갱신, 기술문서 및 포트폴리오 북 생성을 맡는다. 아래 설명은 각 함수와 클래스 독스트링이다.</p>

1081  <pre>def source_link_target(s: SourceRef) -&gt; tuple[str, str]</pre>
1082  <p>원본 종류에 따라 링크에 보일 이름과 클릭 주소를 정한다. 워드와 PDF는 추출 텍스트로, 텍스트·HTML·VB는 원본 경로로 연결한다.</p>

1085  <pre>p ← ROOT / s.path

1087    vb ← p / &#x27;Form1.vb&#x27;
1088    만약 vb.is_file()
1089      rel ← f&quot;{s.path.replace(chr(92), &#x27;/&#x27;)}/Form1.vb&quot;
1090      반환 (&#x27;Form1.vb&#x27;, source_href(rel))
1091    반환 (os.path.basename(s.path), source_href(s.path))
1092  name ← os.path.basename(s.path)

1094  만약 ext in (&#x27;.docx&#x27;, &#x27;.pdf&#x27;)
1095    반환 (f&#x27;{name} (텍스트 추출본)&#x27;, extracted_href(s.path))
1096  만약 ext in (&#x27;.html&#x27;, &#x27;.htm&#x27;, &#x27;.txt&#x27;, &#x27;.vb&#x27;)
1097    반환 (name, source_href(s.path))
1098  반환 (name, source_href(s.path))</pre>

1108  <pre>def mask_assignment_privacy(text: str) -&gt; str</pre>
1109  <p>과제 본문의 지도교수 이름, 학번, 파일명 속 학번 숫자를 가린다.</p>

1111  <p>유사코드</p>
1112  <pre>만약 not text
1113    반환 text
1114  text ← re.sub(&#x27;(지도교수\\s*[:：]\\s*)\\S+(?:\\s*교수님)?&#x27;, f&#x27;\\1{PROFESSOR_MASK}&#x27;, te…
1115  text ← re.sub(&#x27;((?:학\\s*번|수\\s*강\\s*번\\s*호)\\s*[:：]\\s*)\\d+&#x27;, f&#x27;\\1{STUDENT_I…
1116  text ← re.sub(&#x27;\\(\\d{7,8}\\s+&#x27;, f&#x27;({STUDENT_ID_MASK} &#x27;, text)
1117  text ← re.sub(&#x27;\\(\\d{7,8}\\)&#x27;, f&#x27;({STUDENT_ID_MASK})&#x27;, text)
1118  text ← re.sub(&#x27;_\\d{7,8}_&#x27;, f&#x27;_{STUDENT_ID_MASK}_&#x27;, text)

1120  <h4>cache_extract</h4>

1128  out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1129  clean_content ← mask_secrets(content)
1130  out.write_text(clean_content or &#x27;[empty]&#x27;, encoding=&#x27;utf-8&#x27;)

1132  <h4>parse_unit</h4>

1134  <pre>def parse_unit(filename: str) -&gt; str</pre>
1135  <p>파일 이름에서 장, 일차, 강, 주차, 서론, 부록, 코딩면허 같은 학습 단위를 찾는다. 없으면 전체다.</p>
1136  <ul><li>인자: filename: str</li><li>반환: str</li></ul>
1137  <p>유사코드</p>
1138  <pre>name ← filename.replace(&#x27;.txt&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;)
1139  반복 pat ← [&#x27;(\\d+[~\\-]?\\d*)\\s*장&#x27;, &#x27;(\\d+[~\\-]?\\d*)\\s*일차&#x27;, &#x27;(\\d+[~\\-]?\\d*…
1140    m ← re.search(pat, name, re.I)
1141    만약 m
1142      반환 m.group(0)
1143  반환 &#x27;전체&#x27;</pre>
1144  <h4>sort_key_unit</h4>
1145  <p><code>study_note_record_organization/scripts/build_output.py:244</code></p>
1146  <pre>def sort_key_unit(unit: str) -&gt; tuple</pre>
1147  <p>학습 단위를 서론, 구간, 본문, 부록 순으로 정렬하기 위한 키를 만든다.</p>
1148  <ul><li>인자: unit: str</li><li>반환: tuple</li></ul>
1149  <p>유사코드</p>
1150  <pre>만약 unit == &#x27;전체&#x27;
1151    반환 (0, 0)
1152  만약 &#x27;서론&#x27; in unit or &#x27;프롤로그&#x27; in unit
1153    반환 (1, 0)
1154  nums ← re.findall(&#x27;\\d+&#x27;, unit)
1155  n ← int(nums[0]) if nums else 99
1156  만약 &#x27;~&#x27; in unit or &#x27;-&#x27; in unit
1157    반환 (2, n)
1158  만약 &#x27;부록&#x27; in unit
1159    반환 (4, n)
1160  반환 (3, n)</pre>

1187  <h4>CatalogItem.load_sources</h4>
1188  <p><code>study_note_record_organization/scripts/build_output.py:279</code></p>
1189  <pre>def load_sources(self) -&gt; None</pre>
1190  <p>각 원본 파일의 본문을 읽어 text에 채우고, 가린 내용을 추출 캐시에 저장한다. 폴더면 Form1.vb를 합친다.</p>
1191  <ul><li>인자: 없음</li><li>반환: None</li></ul>
1192  <p>유사코드</p>
1193  <pre>반복 s ← self.sources
1194    p ← ROOT / s.path
1195    만약 p.is_file()
1196      s.text ← extract_source(p)
1197      만약 is_assignment_path(s.path)
1198        cache_extract(s.path, mask_assignment_privacy(s.text))
1199      아니면
1200        cache_extract(s.path, s.text)
1201    아니면
1202      만약 p.is_dir()
1203        반복 vb ← sorted(p.rglob(&#x27;*.vb&#x27;))
1204          만약 &#x27;obj&#x27; in vb.parts or &#x27;bin&#x27; in vb.parts
1205            다음 반복
1206          만약 vb.name in (&#x27;Form1.vb&#x27;, &#x27;Form1.Designer.vb&#x27;)
1207            t ← extract_source(vb)
1208            s.text ← s.text 연산 f&#x27;\n\n--- {vb.name} ---\n{t}&#x27;
1209        만약 is_assignment_path(s.path)
1210          cache_extract(s.path, mask_assignment_privacy(s.text))
1211        아니면
1212          cache_extract(s.path, s.text)</pre>
1213  <h4>normalize_study_title</h4>
1214  <p><code>study_note_record_organization/scripts/build_output.py:562</code></p>
1215  <pre>def normalize_study_title(filename: str) -&gt; str</pre>
1216  <p>노트 파일 이름에서 장·일차 번호와 독서노트·수강노트 꼬리를 떼고 과목 이름만 남긴다.</p>
1217  <ul><li>인자: filename: str</li><li>반환: str</li></ul>
1218  <p>유사코드</p>
1219  <pre>n ← filename.replace(&#x27;.txt&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;).replace(&#x27;.docx&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;)
1220  n ← re.sub(&#x27;\\s+(\\d+[~\\-]?\\d*\\s*)?(장|일차|강|주차)\\s*(독서\\s*노트|독서노트|수강노트|영상…
1221  n ← re.sub(&#x27;\\s+(독서노트|수강노트|영상노트|독서 노트)\\s*$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;, n, flags=re.I)
1222  n ← re.sub(&#x27;\\s+코딩면허.*$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;, n, flags=re.I)
1223  n ← re.sub(&#x27;\\s+노트는\\s*실습.*$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;, n, flags=re.I)
1224  n ← re.sub(&#x27;\\s+실습\\s*필기.*$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;, n, flags=re.I)
1225  n ← re.sub(&#x27;\\s+실습위주.*$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;, n, flags=re.I)
1226  n ← re.sub(&#x27;\\s+통합\\(단순합치기\\).*$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;, n)
1227  반환 n.strip()</pre>
1228  <h4>collect_study_groups</h4>

1230  <pre>def collect_study_groups() -&gt; dict[str, list[str]]</pre>
1231  <p>data 폴더의 텍스트·워드 노트를 과목 이름으로 묶는다. hwpx는 빼고, 별칭은 같은 과목으로 합친 뒤 장·강 순으로 정렬한다.</p>

1233  <p>유사코드</p>
1234  <pre>raw ← {}
1235  skipped_hwpx ← []
1236  반복 f ← sorted(DATA.iterdir())
1237    만약 not f.is_file()
1238      다음 반복
1239    ext ← f.suffix.lower()
1240    만약 ext == &#x27;.hwpx&#x27;
1241      skipped_hwpx.append(f.name)
1242      다음 반복
1243    만약 ext not in (&#x27;.txt&#x27;, &#x27;.docx&#x27;)
1244      다음 반복
1245    base ← normalize_study_title(f.name)
1246    raw.setdefault(base, []).append(f&#x27;data/{f.name}&#x27;)
1247  merged ← {}

1249    canonical ← STUDY_MERGE_ALIASES.get(base, base)
1250    merged.setdefault(canonical, []).extend(paths)
1251  반복 paths ← merged.values()
1252    paths.sort(key=lambda p: sort_key_unit(parse_unit(os.path.basename(p))))
1253  반환 (merged, skipped_hwpx)</pre>

1281    items.append(CatalogItem(id=f&#x27;study-{slug}&#x27;, type=&#x27;study&#x27;, category=cat…

1392    s ← ln.strip()
1393    만약 in_cover
1394      만약 not s
1395        다음 반복

1397        다음 반복

1400        다음 반복
1401      만약 re.search(&#x27;과\\s*제\\s*주\\s*제\\s*[:：]&#x27;, s, re.I)

1405        만약 re.match(&#x27;^[•\\-\\*·]&#x27;, s)

1408          skip_topic_lines ← False
1409          다음 반복
1410        다음 반복
1411      만약 re.match(&#x27;^(?:서론|목차|본론|결론)\\b&#x27;, s)
1412        in_cover ← False
1413        kept.append(ln)
1414        다음 반복
1415      만약 s.startswith(&#x27; &#x27;) or len(s) &gt; 55
1416        in_cover ← False
1417        kept.append(ln)
1418        다음 반복
1419      만약 len(s) &lt;= 40
1420        다음 반복
1421      in_cover ← False
1422      kept.append(ln)
1423    아니면
1424      kept.append(ln)
1425  반환 &#x27;\n&#x27;.join(kept)</pre>

1696  <h4>is_prose_line</h4>
1697  <p><code>study_note_record_organization/scripts/build_output.py:1148</code></p>
1698  <pre>def is_prose_line(line: str) -&gt; bool</pre>
1699  <p>한글이 있고 코드·로그·너무 짧거나 긴 줄이 아닌 서술 줄인지 판별한다.</p>
1700  <ul><li>인자: line: str</li><li>반환: bool</li></ul>
1701  <p>유사코드</p>
1702  <pre>s ← line.strip()
1703  만약 len(s) &lt; 12 or len(s) &gt; 280
1704    반환 False
1705  만약 not _HANGUL.search(s)
1706    반환 False
1707  만약 _CODE_NOISE.match(s)
1708    반환 False
1709  만약 s.count(&#x27;=&#x27;) &gt; 4 or s.startswith(&#x27;---&#x27;)
1710    반환 False
1711  ascii_ratio ← sum((1 for c in s if ord(c) &lt; 128)) / len(s)
1712  만약 ascii_ratio &gt; 0.65 and &#x27;파이썬&#x27; not in s and (&#x27;프로그래&#x27; not in s)
1713    반환 False
1714  반환 True</pre>

1728    key ← ln[:50]

1733    만약 len(points) &gt;= max_items

1989  <pre>def parse_frontmatter(raw: str) -&gt; tuple[dict, str]</pre>
1990  <p>마크다운 앞의 YAML 프론트매터를 딕셔너리와 본문으로 나눈다. 태그 목록과 sources도 읽는다.</p>
1991  <ul><li>인자: raw: str</li><li>반환: tuple[dict, str]</li></ul>
1992  <p>유사코드</p>
1993  <pre>match ← re.match(&#x27;^---\\r?\\n([\\s\\S]*?)\\r?\\n---\\r?\\n([\\s\\S]*)$&#x27;, raw)
1994  만약 not match
1995    반환 ({}, raw)
1996  (yaml, body) ← (match.group(1), match.group(2))
1997  meta ← {}
1998  current_key ← None
1999  in_sources ← False
2000  source_item ← None
2001  반복 line ← yaml.split(&#x27;\n&#x27;)
2002    만약 line.strip().startswith(&#x27;sources:&#x27;)
2003      in_sources ← True
2004      meta[&#x27;sources&#x27;] ← []
2005      다음 반복
2006    만약 in_sources
2007      만약 re.match(&#x27;^\\s+-\\s+path:&#x27;, line)
2008        source_item ← {&#x27;path&#x27;: line.split(&#x27;path:&#x27;, 1)[1].strip()}
2009        meta[&#x27;sources&#x27;].append(source_item)
2010      아니면
2011        만약 source_item and re.match(&#x27;^\\s+unit:&#x27;, line)
2012          source_item[&#x27;unit&#x27;] ← line.split(&#x27;unit:&#x27;, 1)[1].strip().strip(&#x27;&quot;\&#x27;&#x27;)
2013        아니면
2014          만약 line.strip() and (not line.startswith(&#x27; &#x27;))
2015            in_sources ← False
2016    만약 not in_sources
2017      m ← re.match(&#x27;^(\\w+):\\s*(.*)$&#x27;, line)
2018      만약 m
2019        current_key ← m.group(1)
2020        val ← m.group(2).strip().strip(&#x27;&quot;\&#x27;&#x27;)
2021        meta[current_key] ← val
2022      아니면
2023        만약 current_key == &#x27;tags&#x27; and re.match(&#x27;^\\s+-\\s+&#x27;, line)
2024          meta.setdefault(&#x27;tags&#x27;, [])
2025          meta[&#x27;tags&#x27;].append(line.split(&#x27;-&#x27;, 1)[1].strip())
2026  만약 isinstance(meta.get(&#x27;tags&#x27;), str) and meta[&#x27;tags&#x27;].startswith(&#x27;[&#x27;)
2027    시도
2028      meta[&#x27;tags&#x27;] ← json.loads(meta[&#x27;tags&#x27;].replace(&quot;&#x27;&quot;, &#x27;&quot;&#x27;))
2029    실패 json.JSONDecodeError
2030      meta[&#x27;tags&#x27;] ← []
2031  반환 (meta, body)</pre>

2183  <p><code>study_note_record_organization/scripts/build_static_site.py:281</code></p>
2184  <pre>def source_chunk_filename(key: str, text: str) -&gt; str</pre>
2185  <p>원본 키와 본문 해시로 sources 폴더에 저장할 JSON 파일 이름을 만든다.</p>

2498  <h2 class="">생성 산출물</h2>
2499  <p>다음 파일은 사람이 함수를 적어 둔 소스가 아니다. build_static_site.py를 다시 실행하면 data.js, hero-images.js, sources JSON의 본문이 바뀌므로 그 안에 설명 주석을 넣지 않았다.</p>
2500  <ul><li>study_note_record_organization/dashboard/js/data.js — 카드 목록, 요약 HTML, 원본 파일 지도를 window.SITE_DATA로 넣는다.</li><li>study_note_record_organization/dashboard/js/hero-images.js — data/image 경로를 window.HERO_IMAGES 배열로 넣는다.</li><li>study_note_record_organization/dashboard/js/sources/*.json — 원본 텍스트 141개. 키와 본문만 담는다.</li></ul>

  5  <title>코드북</title>
